jobs.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer - Efficiency Engineering
jobs.excerpt: About ClickHouseRecognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies.
jobs.description:
About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About the Team

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineering team builds and manages the foundational blocks of ClickHouse Cloud data plane end-to-end. This includes compute, networking, security, and a multi-cloud, multi-region architecture that provides a reliable and scalable managed ClickHouse experience for ClickHouse Cloud customers. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced cloud infrastructure software engineers to join our team, who will be responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining our infrastructure.

What will you do?

  • Architect and build a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.
  • Build a cutting-edge cloud-native platform on top of the public cloud, and automate our cloud resource management.
  • Execute high-impact infrastructure optimization initiatives across compute, storage, and networking.
  • Collaborate with the ClickHouse engineering teams to develop high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective solutions for our SaaS platform.
  • Optimize cost efficiency systematically through the implementation of distributed systems and industry best practices.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to design and construct tooling for cost efficiency insights.

About you:

  • 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems.
  • Software development experience in Go, C/C++, Java, or another OOP language.
  • Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience developing cloud infrastructure services, preferably with Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing cloud native edge or service mesh services, preferably with envoy and Istio.
  • Experience leading and shipping large scope technical projects in collaboration with multiple experienced engineers.
  • Understanding of network topologies, protocols, and security principles, such as VPNs, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including encryption, access controls, and compliance standards like SOC2 and GDPR.
  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a global team.
  • You are a strong problem-solver and have solid production debugging skills.
  • You are passionate about efficiency, availability, scalability and data governance.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.
  • You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability

Compensation

For roles based in the United States, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed above. In certain locations, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City Metro Area, a premium market range may apply, as listed.

These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments.

An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.

If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at .

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 20 countries.
  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
  • A $500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.description:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are searching for a highly skilled Customer Success Engineer to play a key role in optimizing our customers' utilization and return on investment in Cyera. This position offers an exciting chance to join a thriving organization and contribute to the forefront of data security, making a significant impact on the protection of data for numerous global enterprises. As part of this role, you can expect to travel between 25-50% annually, enabling you to engage directly with clients and enhance their overall experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

As a Customer Success Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring customer satisfaction and success by:

  • Serving as the primary technical expert on the Cyera Platform, demonstrating in-depth knowledge and expertise.
  • Establishing yourself as a trusted advisor to customers at all levels, from practitioners to executives.
  • Driving customer adoption through effective onboarding and training processes.
  • Gaining a deep understanding of customers' requirements, challenges, and desired business outcomes, and then designing and delivering customized use cases that align with their goals using a consultative approach.
  • Proactively ensuring that customers are realizing the full value of their investment and maximizing their return on investment by consistently driving sustained adoption of Cyera's platform. You will act as the leader for ongoing engagement and expansion, helping customers achieve their business and technology objectives.
  • Proactively identifying and resolving any obstacles or blockers that may impede customer success, collaborating with peers to address them promptly.
  • Advocating for the customer's voice and feedback, actively influencing Cyera's roadmap and product development.
  • Utilizing self-paced training resources to support customer education and promote knowledge growth throughout their journey.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues impacting customers, ensuring smooth operation and seamless experiences.
  • Monitoring and reporting on the overall well-being of customers, tracking key health and usage indicators.
  • Collaborating with customers to develop joint success plans.
  • Documenting and sharing best practices both internally and externally to foster knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Mentoring other team members, sharing your expertise and assisting in their professional development.
  • Participating in the interview process to help identify and onboard talented individuals to the team.
  • Conducting Quarterly Business Reviews with customers, evaluating progress, and identifying areas for further improvement and collaboration.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associates degree or equivalent experience required. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar experience a plus
  • 12 years experience in Strong project management skills, enabling you to effectively plan, organize, and execute multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a strong attention to detail
  • A self-starter who thrives in an ambiguous, fast-paced, and deadline-oriented startup environment.
  • A results-oriented mindset, with a proven track record of driving revenue growth, ensuring customer satisfaction, promoting feature adoption, and maximizing customer retention.
  • Prior experience collaborating with Development teams.
  • Proficiency in SQL, scripting languages (e.g., Python or equivalent), and hands-on experience with cloud environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with data technologies and cloud technologies, including databases, cloud infrastructure and basic administration (e.g., cloud networking, data and compute assets, IAM and permissions, etc,)
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages and familiarity with APIs and web services
  • Demonstrated expertise in DLP (Data Loss Prevention), Data Privacy/Protection, DSPM/CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management), SIEM (Security Information and Event Management), or vulnerability management with hands-on experience preferred.
  • Prior experience working in a software company in a technical customer-facing role is essential.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning customer relationships, including onboarding, renewal, and expansion.
  • A self-motivated, proactive, and innovative team player who consistently strives to inspire customer loyalty.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer relations skills, particularly when it comes to building and nurturing strategic relationships.
  • A clear and concise verbal and written communicator, capable of conveying complex information effectively.
  • Proficiency in leading both executive meetings and technical workshops, demonstrating confidence and expertise.
  • Ability to work autonomously, tackling even the most intricate challenges, and successfully completing tasks that may lack comprehensive documentation. They will actively participate in projects aligned with their current skill set, seeking assistance primarily for more complex initiatives or issues.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $220,000-$240,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

﻿BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

jobs.excerpt: The RoleAt Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact.
jobs.description:
The Role

At Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact. As an Onboarding Specialist, you'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless and empowering experience for new Uscreen customers. From first contact through launch, you'll guide customers through the onboarding journey and ensure successful adoption of our platform. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to coordinate smooth, timely launches for customers with more complex needs, making sure every detail is aligned for success.

In this role, you'll blend project management, platform expertise, and customer relationship building to create a strong foundation for long-term success. You'll do it inside an AI-native team: we treat AI as a core part of how we work, using it to move faster, personalize every customer touchpoint, and spend more of our time on the high-judgment work that actually drives launches. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast paced, high touch environments, is energized by using AI to raise the bar on their own output, and is excited to support customers with unique needs.

🚀 What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new customers during their onboarding and platform launch.
  • Manage an onboarding book of business of 50 to 80 customers at a time, keeping every launch organized, on track, and moving toward activation.
  • Deliver a proactive, high-touch onboarding experience for our high-value customers, using AI to tailor communications, anticipate needs, and keep every launch on track.
  • Guide customers step-by-step through platform setup, configuration, and activation.
  • Deliver training, product education, and light technical support so customers feel confident using the platform, building and refining reusable resources (guides, templates, walkthroughs) with the help of AI tools.
  • Partner with internal launch stakeholders, including the App Launch and Migrations teams, to coordinate seamless platform activations, ensuring customer assets, apps, and data are delivered on time, accurately, and aligned with launch expectations.
  • Drive adoption and reduce time-to-value by aligning onboarding activities with customer goals and ROI expectations.
  • Monitor progress and proactively surface blockers or risk factors that could delay launch or affect customer satisfaction, using AI-assisted workflows to track portfolio health at scale.
  • Communicate with your customer portfolio via email, phone, video, and SMS, based on customer preferences and urgency.
  • Use AI daily to draft customer-facing communications, summarize calls and account context, prep for kickoffs, and automate repetitive steps, then apply your own judgment to make the output accurate, on-brand, and genuinely helpful.
  • Contribute to how the team works with AI by sharing prompts, workflows, and improvements that make onboarding faster and better for everyone.
  • Support internal feedback loops by sharing onboarding insights with the product, support, and customer success teams.

🔥 What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Implementation, Customer Success, or Account Management, ideally in a SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in your day-to-day work, with a track record of using them to improve the quality, speed, or consistency of your output. This is a core requirement of the role.
  • Strong judgment for when to rely on AI and when to step in. You review AI output critically and take ownership of accuracy, tone, and customer impact.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a proactive, customer-first mindset.
  • Confidence explaining technical concepts in a simple, approachable way.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally to execute client deliverables on time.
  • High adaptability, a sense of urgency, and comfort working remotely.
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset toward emerging AI tools and workflows. You're excited to experiment and keep leveling up how you work.
  • Familiarity with platforms related to video hosting, content creation, or digital communities is a bonus.
  • Passion for helping customers succeed and a team-player attitude.

💛 How We Work, Our Values

These are the five values we hold ourselves to, and what they look like in this role:

  • Customer Obsessed. You treat every creator's business like it's your own, going above and beyond to surprise and delight through responsiveness, care, and a willingness to do whatever it takes.
  • Push the Pace. You move quickly to make progress and keep launches in motion. You launch, learn, and make it better every day, including how you use AI to move faster.
  • Own the Outcome. You do what you say you'll do and take accountability for successful, on-time launches, owning the result whether the work is yours or AI-assisted.
  • Simplicity Wins. You make complex platform concepts easy for customers to understand, decide on, and use.
  • Go Further Together. You invest in your relationships with teammates, customers, and partners, building the trust that defines our success.

Our Commitment to You

  • We will compensate you competitively.
  • It's a marathon, not a sprint. We'll make sure you have a clear growth plan to help you reach the next level at Uscreen.
  • 100% Remote. Work from wherever your heart desires, as long as you have stable internet and a conducive workspace.
  • Our flexible, unlimited PTO policy encourages every team member to take the time they need to unwind and recharge.
  • We also offer flexible parental leave.
  • Your home office should be ergonomic and inspirational to help you make some magic. We'll give you a generous WFH stipend to help you set one up.
  • And if WFH isn't for you, we're happy to pay for your coworking space.

The Quality Manager will play a critical role in driving continuous improvement, conducting quality audits, supporting SAFe Agile delivery teams, and ensuring ongoing compliance with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) quality requirements across modernization, maintenance, and enhancement efforts.

Responsibilities:

The Quality Manager’s responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing, implementing, and maintaining the program’s Quality Assurance framework in alignment with the PWS and QASP requirements.• Ensuring all program deliverables meet QASP performance metrics and quality thresholds defined by the customer.• Designing inspection, testing, and verification processes to evaluate quality across all functional and technical task areas.• Conducting audits of quality systems, processes, and work products; documenting findings; and ensuring timely resolution of corrective actions.• Producing QASP self‑assessment reports and other required quality documentation, including metrics dashboards and trend analyses.• Providing quality oversight and support across SAFe Agile teams, including monitoring defect trends, sprint quality outputs, and Definition of Done adherence.• Leading continuous improvement initiatives using industry‑standard methodologies (e.g., root‑cause analysis, process optimization, CAPA).• Ensuring program compliance with CMS quality standards, contractual requirements, and all applicable federal guidelines.• Supporting audit readiness efforts, including preparing evidence, interfacing with auditors, and coordinating remediation activities.• Collaborating with cross‑functional project leadership, engineering teams, and customer stakeholders to drive a culture of quality across all delivery areas.• Maintaining configuration and documentation control practices to ensure quality baselines are accurate, compliant, and traceable.• Monitoring supplier and subcontractor performance as applicable, ensuring adherence to quality requirements and acceptance criteria.

jobs.description:
About us

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Many of our team members call the San Francisco Bay Area home, but this role is fully remote across Canada.

About the Role

Fluxon is a culture-driven, dynamic software consulting company, and this Lead Talent Partner role is about as "choose your own adventure" as recruiting gets. You'll have real ownership over how hiring works across the Americas — with huge room to shape the role, the process, and the impact you make.

We're looking for someone who's excited to own the full recruitment lifecycle end-to-end, while staying organized, motivated, and genuinely invested in helping candidates reach their potential.

As Lead Talent Partner, you'll:

  • Lead full cycle recruitment across the Americas — sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and hiring for senior technical roles across teams including Product Management and Engineering
  • Quickly build high-trust relationships across the company and with hiring managers — including at the Director level — positioning yourself as a true partner in their hiring decisions, not just a service that fills reqs
  • Communicate clearly and confidently, whether you're writing candidate outreach or briefing senior stakeholders
  • Build recruiting plans and strategy that grow our candidate pool for current and future hiring needs
  • Proactively source passive candidates across major job platforms (e.g. LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Collaborate with the People Operations team to create the best possible candidate experience throughout the recruiting process and onboarding
  • Track the metrics that actually predict good hires — not just fill rate, but quality and speed of process
  • Take ownership of how we improve — surface friction, propose solutions, drive them to done

Qualifications

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have 3+ years of technical recruiting experience
  • Have experience working with a globally distributed team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable partnering with Director-level hiring managers, and see yourself as a trusted advisor rather than a service provider
  • Love digging into metrics and using them to guide decisions
  • Have a constant drive to improve processes and iterate on how things work
  • Open to recruiting across functions — product, engineering, operations, and beyond
  • Think creatively, lead initiatives, and drive an exceptional candidate experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience developing hiring processes at a fast-scaling tech company

What we offer

Our salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000 CAD and we consider your skills and experience and what similar roles pay at companies similar to us when determining your offer.

  • Remote work with flexible hours and a budget to set up your work space
  • Localized healthcare coverage designed to support you and your family’s well-being
  • Flexible paid time off with a 3-week minimum (not including holidays) to support your well-being
  • Company-wide "no internal meetings" Fridays to help you focus on deep, uninterrupted work
  • Professional growth budget for any form of self-improvement: specialized technical training, conferences, certifications or even foreign language courses
  • Monthly health & wellness allowance to spend on whatever keeps you physically and mentally at your best
  • Annual off-sites where we gather in person to build meaningful connections with your fellow Fluxonians
  • Profit-sharing program for you to benefit directly from our collective growth and success
  • Paid sabbatical program to reset, recharge, and gain a fresh perspective

We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organization. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process.

This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer.

jobs.title: Advanced Utilization Management Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The Advanced Utilization Management Operations Specialist provides advanced operational expertise to support complex case resolution, utilization management inventory oversight, escalations, and workflow support.
jobs.description:
The Advanced Utilization Management Operations Specialist provides advanced operational expertise to support complex case resolution, utilization management inventory oversight, escalations, and workflow support. This position is responsible for investigating authorization cases and operational issues that cannot be resolved through standard workflows, determining where breakdowns occurred, and driving issues through resolution.

The Advanced Utilization Management Operations Specialist partners with clinical, operational, quality, compliance, medical policy, coding, configuration, and client facing teams to ensure case resolution and recommendations are accurate, compliant, operationally sound, and completed timely. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, critical thinking, organization, sound operational judgment, and the ability to manage multiple high priority issues while maintaining follow through.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Complex Case Escalation and Resolution
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex, incorrectly processed, or difficult to resolve authorization cases.
  • Investigate provider, health plan, and internal escalations to determine what occurred, what should have occurred, and the appropriate corrective action.
  • Reconstruct case activity across systems, documentation, benefit information, authorization history, and workflow activity to identify root cause.
  • Resolve cases that cannot be addressed through standard frontline workflows and coordinate resolution across teams when necessary.
  • Ensure identified issues are followed through to completion rather than transferred between teams without resolution.
  • Escalate potential member impact, compliance concerns, or systemic issues to appropriate leadership.
UM Inventory Management
  • Support daily management and oversight of utilization management inventory.
  • Identify cases that are missing, misrouted, stalled, incorrectly assigned, or located outside the expected workflow.
  • Investigate discrepancies between operational inventory, system activity, and reporting.
  • Identify inventory at risk of exceeding required turnaround times and assist with prioritization and resolution.
  • Support management of aged, complex, or otherwise difficult to resolve inventory.
  • Proactively identify workflow or inventory patterns that could create future operational risk.

Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving
  • Investigate operational errors and workflow breakdowns to determine the underlying cause.
  • Distinguish between individual performance issues, training or knowledge gaps, unclear processes, system configuration issues, benefit interpretation issues, and broader operational defects.
  • Identify recurring patterns across escalations and individual case findings.
  • Recommend practical corrective actions based on identified root causes.
  • Partner with UM leadership, Quality, Compliance, Medical Policy, Coding, Configuration, and other teams as appropriate to resolve identified issues.
  • Support remediation and follow through when issues have potential client, member, provider, or regulatory impact.
UM Operational Subject Matter Expertise
  • Serve as a resource to frontline staff and leadership for complex DMEPOS utilization management workflows.
  • Apply knowledge of benefit determination, eligibility, authorization requirements, clinical review pathways, and operational requirements when resolving cases.
  • Understand and reinforce the appropriate order of operations and critical decision points required for accurate authorization processing.
  • Help staff determine how to approach unfamiliar scenarios rather than relying solely on scenario specific instructions.
  • Support development and refinement of operational workflows, reference materials, escalation pathways, and decision support tools.
Key Competencies
  • Critical thinking, problem solving, complex case investigation, and root cause identification.
  • DMEPOS and utilization management knowledge, inventory management, and workflow management.
  • Attention to detail, operational decision making, accountability, and follow through.
  • Cross functional collaboration and ability to work effectively in a fast paced and evolving environment.
Measures of Success
  • Timely resolution of complex UM escalations.
  • Reduction in unresolved, stalled, or misrouted inventory.
  • Reduction in repeat operational errors and rework.
  • Improved identification and resolution of root causes.
  • Improved adherence to established UM workflows and critical decision points.
  • Timely identification and escalation of potential member, client, or compliance risk.
  • Improved operational stability and efficiency across the utilization management function

Pay: $24.00/hour

EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required;
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Business Administration,
  • or related field preferred.
Experience:
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in utilization management, prior authorization, healthcare operations, or a related healthcare function preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of utilization management and prior authorization workflows required.
  • DMEPOS experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience researching and resolving complex authorization, benefit, or operational issues required.
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan requirements preferred.
  • Experience with delegated utilization management preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between benefit coverage, authorization requirements, clinical review, and operational processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate multiple systems and sources of information to reconstruct case activity and determine root cause.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, critical thinking, and problem solving skills.
  • Ability to recognize patterns and distinguish isolated errors from broader process or system issues.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple high priority issues simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, quality, compliance, and client facing teams.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.

Benefits Offered

  • Competitive compensation and annual bonus program
  • 401(k) retirement program with company match
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Company-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply)
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Sick Time
  • Paid company holidays and floating holidays
  • Quarterly company-sponsored events
  • Health and wellness programs
  • Career development opportunities

Remote Opportunities

We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

Our Story

Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits.

With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. See what opportunities we have available; there may be a role for you to engage in a challenging yet rewarding career in healthcare. We look forward to learning more about you.

Integra Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.excerpt: About Homeaglow Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes.
jobs.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

About the Role

Homeaglow is looking for a Director of Finance who thinks like an operator and acts like a strategist. This is not a role for someone who lives in variance reports. We want someone who uses financial data as a lens to understand our business, identify leverage points, and help leadership make better decisions faster.

You will be a key voice in the room when we are deciding where to invest, what to cut, how to price, and how to grow. You will own the financial narrative of the company — not just the numbers behind it.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Partner directly with the leadership team to translate financial data into strategic recommendations — pricing, unit economics, capital allocation, and growth bets.
  • Build and maintain financial models that drive decision-making, not just report history. Your models should answer “what should we do” as much as “what happened.”
  • Identify inflection points in the business before they show up in the income statement — through cohort analysis, leading indicators, and operational metrics.
  • Evaluate new initiatives, partnerships, and investments with rigorous but fast financial analysis. Be the person who pressure-tests ideas without killing momentum.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our unit economics (CAC, LTV, RNR, contribution margin) and communicate them clearly to inform resource allocation and prioritization.

Finance & Accounting Oversight

  • Lead and develop the Finance and Accounting teams, setting high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and analytical rigor.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process — but orient your team toward forward-looking insight, not just backward-looking reconciliation.
  • Ensure financial reporting is clean, consistent, and audit-ready. Establish controls and processes that scale with the business.
  • Manage cash flow, runway, and treasury with a clear-eyed view of the company’s financial position at all times.
  • Oversee tax strategy and compliance, working with external advisors as needed.

Planning & Forecasting

  • Drive the annual planning process — not as an exercise in spreadsheet management, but as a tool for aligning the company on priorities and trade-offs.
  • Maintain a rolling forecast that reflects real business dynamics, not just last year plus a growth rate.
  • Build scenario models that help leadership understand the financial implications of different strategic paths.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in FP&A, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth startup.
  • Demonstrated experience influencing business strategy with financial analysis — not just building models, but changing decisions.
  • Strong command of unit economics, cohort modeling, and the financial drivers of marketplace or subscription businesses.
  • Exceptional communicator who can translate complex financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Prior experience managing a finance or accounting team.
  • High comfort with ambiguity. You don’t need perfect data to form a useful point of view.
  • Low ego, high standards. You’d rather be right than look smart.

Who Thrives Here

This role is ideal for a finance leader who is energized by the question “what does this mean for the business?” — not “how do we explain the variance?” You should be as comfortable in a strategic planning meeting as you are reviewing a reconciliation. You move fast, communicate crisply, and treat financial analysis as a means to an end: building a better business.

This role is not for someone looking to run a tightly scoped accounting function or whose primary output is monthly close packages. We have operational finance needs and you will own them — but that is the floor, not the ceiling.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave.
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

So whether you're a digital nomad or a remote-first company, we've got you covered.

Ready to join the future of work? Let's build something amazing together. As we value work-life balance, please only apply if you're based within 2 hours of the Central European Timezone.

Our Payroll team is looking for a detail-oriented, highly organised, and motivated individual to join us as a Senior Payroll Specialist. In this role, you'll be the primary owner of a portfolio of entity and partner payrolls, ensuring compliant, accurate and timely delivery while providing an exceptional experience to our clients and their employees.

What you will do as a Senior Payroll Specialist...

  • Independently manage end-to-end monthly payroll cycles for an assigned portfolio of entity and partner payrolls, in line with our Confluence country process guides and SLAs.
  • Coordinate data collection, validation, and submission to outsourced vendors/partners, ensuring inputs are complete, accurate, and on time.
  • Review vendor draft payrolls and supporting reports, performing detailed checks and reconciliations (gross-to-net, contributions, employer cost) before sign-off according to the approval matrix.

Requirements

What we are looking for…

  • Strong experience in end-to-end payroll operations, including working with outsourced payroll vendors or partners, with a proven track record of managing multiple payrolls or entities independently.
  • Deep legislative and operational payroll knowledge in at least one country, with the ability to interpret and apply statutory rules using official guidance and internal knowledge tools (Guru/Confluence).
  • Solid understanding of gross-to-net calculations, employer and employee social contributions, and total employer cost concepts, plus experience using and maintaining payroll tools such as cost calculators and reconciliation templates.
  • Excellent communication skills with a strong customer service mindset, able to explain complex payroll topics in simple, empathetic terms to non‑experts.
  • High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a structured, process-driven approach to problem solving, including adherence to approval matrices and documented procedures.

Benefits

  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

jobs.excerpt: Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults.
jobs.description:
Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor’s growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world’s leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

About Us

Honor Technology's mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor's growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world's leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 60 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

About the Role

As Senior Director, People Partners, you will lead the evolution of our HRBP function to operate as a true organizational architect: identifying systemic problems before they become crises, designing mechanisms that produce the right talent outcomes, and becoming a sought-after partner to senior leaders. You will lead a small team of HRBPs, set the standard for how this function operates, and serve as a credible, trusted voice in senior leadership conversations — someone who earns influence by being right, honest, bringing insights and patterns that leaders may not see but need to understand, and proactively helping leaders reach their goals through people, structure, and culture.

This role is fully remote.

About the People Team

The People team at Honor builds the infrastructure, practices, and leadership capability to help the company achieve its goals through its people, structure, and culture. We aim to act as a force multiplier — aligning people and purpose to drive growth, adaptability, and long-term value. Our work is both strategic and operational: finding and hiring talented people, ensuring the people and culture "scaffolding" are in place for the company to evolve and scale, continuously examining and improving how work gets done and information flows, supporting and strengthening leaders, and ensuring the fundamentals of risk mitigation, pay, and policy are executed reliably.

As Senior Director of HR Business Partnership at Honor, you will:

Raise manager and leadership quality — Help leaders understand that manager-employee relationships are the primary driver of team performance, retention, and culture. Build manager capability, feedback loops, and coaching infrastructure that make strong manager-employee relationships the norm, not the exception. Support succession planning and leadership bench development. (Leadership Principle: Drive Impact)

Drive organizational effectiveness — Build trust-based relationships with business leaders to partner on organizational design: assess structure, clarity of roles and decision rights, and alignment with business strategy. Strengthen the organization's change management capabilities and agility. Act as a connector across functions — bringing objectivity, empathy, expertise, and sound judgment to complex, cross-cutting people issues.

Build scalable people solutions that drive business impact. Look beyond individual issues to identify root causes, patterns, and systemic challenges, then develop sustainable, repeatable solutions that improve how the organization operates. Test new approaches through practical, data-informed experimentation, learn quickly, and scale what works. Leverage HR data, workforce analytics, and emerging technologies to identify trends, mitigate risk, and improve engagement, retention, performance, and organizational effectiveness. Measure success through meaningful business and people outcomes—not simply completed activities. (Leadership Principle: Think Systemically)

Own employee relations and risk — Lead employee relations for our fully-remote HQ team. Identify and resolve ER issues with speed and sound judgment. Bring strong multi-state wage and hour knowledge and solid understanding of employment law and HR best practices. Maintain working knowledge of employee relations dynamics and know when to engage additional expertise. Support performance management with rigor — teach and enable managers to set clear expectations, provide clear feedback, and address performance issues promptly. (Leadership Principle: Identify Problems)

Lead and develop the HRBP team — Manage, coach, and develop a small team of HRBPs, raising the bar on quality, speed, and judgment. Build observability and repeatability into the team's work through tools, playbooks, and decision frameworks. Lead and evolve the HRBP practice as a strategic center of excellence, defining clear operating principles, standards, and expectations for consistent, high-quality HR partnership across the organization.

Partner on hiring quality — Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to sharpen hiring criteria, improve structured interview practices, and strengthen calibration. Help leaders understand what they are actually hiring for given the needs of the organization now and in the future, not just what they think they want.

We're looking for you to bring:

Required:

  • 10–12+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant time in a senior HRBP or HR leadership role
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Professional HR certification (SPHR, SHRM-SCP) is a plus
  • Experience supporting a mixed workforce — knowledge workers alongside operations, call center, or field staff — in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment
  • Multi-state US employment law fluency; demonstrated experience navigating wage and hour complexity for non-exempt populations
  • Experience in a growth-stage or rapidly scaling company; you've built or rebuilt HR infrastructure before, not just maintained it
  • Demonstrated experience translating business strategy into org design; you've structured teams, clarified decision rights, and helped leaders navigate restructuring decisions
  • Track record of building manager capability — not just delivering training
  • Strong analytical capability, with experience finding and using HR data and workforce insights to identify trends, inform strategy, and drive measurable outcomes
  • Comfort leveraging technology and data to build workflows, analyze data, and scale the function's capacity
  • Ability to communicate in clear, structured, written narratives that distill complexity, sharpen thinking, and scaffold decisions

What distinguishes the right candidate:

  • Pattern recognition — You spot issues early — in data, in conversations, in org dynamics — before they become problems. You go to the source: you connect data to anecdotes, audit what is actually happening, and don't manage from assumptions. You are not waiting to be asked.
  • Systems thinking — When something goes wrong once, you fix it. When it goes wrong again, you build a mechanism. You think in first principles, root causes, and leverage points, not symptoms and one-offs. You deconstruct problems into their inputs and constraints before proposing solutions.
  • Business credibility — You understand metrics, incentives, and operational constraints. You speak the language of business leaders, not just HR practitioners. Senior leaders seek you out early because you're valuable. You have a demonstrated ability to drive change through an organization.
  • Honest and direct — You tell leaders what they need to hear, not what they want to hear. You don't avoid hard truths. You know the difference between being diplomatic and being evasive. You admit when you are wrong or don’t have an immediate answer.
  • Builder mindset — You have a track record of making functions better. You know the difference between improving a process and building a capability.
  • Entrepreneurial drive — You can create order from ambiguity, prioritize appropriately, are willing to roll up your sleeves, and understand that at our stage, building and doing are not separate activities.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 6 months:

  • Senior leaders are actively seeking out this person
  • The HRBP team has clear expectations, better tools and is operating with consistency and repeatability
  • The most significant ER and compliance risks are identified, documented, and being managed proactively. Patterns have been identified and root cause solutions to minimize future occurrence are underway, with measures of success pre-identified.
  • This leader has an honest assessment of where the function is and a credible plan for where it needs to go

In the first year:

  • Measurable improvement in manager capability and manager-employee relationship quality

  • Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential tied to renewals, upsells, and client results.

Why You Should Work Here

Work That Matters: You help connect families looking for quality child care with the businesses that serve them. The work you do directly supports the growth of child care and early education businesses.

Recession-Proof Growth: Join an established, fast-growing company operating in a market where effective marketing and lead generation remain essential.

Leadership That Has Your Back: Work alongside a supportive team that values your development and gives you the support you need to succeed.

An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a strong team and company.

Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a friendly, tight-knit environment where your contributions are visible and valued.

Quarterly Town Halls: Get a clear, company-wide update every quarter so you always understand where the business is headed.

The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes submitted directly by team members through their dream boards.

25 Days Off: Enjoy 25 paid days off per year because having a great career shouldn't mean sacrificing your life outside work.

Paid Days to Give Back: Receive 4 paid days per year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you’ll build strong relationships across your client portfolio and begin taking full ownership of client success. Ongoing success will be measured by:

  • Renewals: Retain and renew clients by consistently demonstrating the value we deliver.
  • Client Success: Help child care businesses achieve measurable marketing results.
  • Upsells: Identify opportunities to expand accounts with services that genuinely support client growth.
  • Testimonials & Reviews: Turn successful client relationships into testimonials, reviews, and case studies.
  • Client Communication: Keep clients informed, confident, and engaged through proactive communication.
  • Internal Collaboration: Coordinate effectively with strategists, media buyers, designers, copywriters, and operations teams.

  • Leading client check-in calls and explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what comes next.
  • Reviewing campaign performance and translating data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Following up on renewals, upsell opportunities, testimonials, and client satisfaction.
  • Coordinating with internal specialists to keep campaigns and deliverables moving.
  • Proactively reaching out to clients before they have to ask for an update.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve results, increase enrollment, and solve client marketing challenges.

Relationship Builder: You earn trust quickly and make clients feel heard, supported, and valued.

Clear Communicator: You can explain marketing strategy, performance, and results in simple, confident language.

Proactive & Organized: You stay ahead of deadlines, follow through on commitments, and manage multiple accounts without letting things slip.

Results-Driven: You are comfortable with data and use performance insights to guide decisions and demonstrate value.

Consultative Seller: You recognize opportunities to help clients do more and can recommend additional services naturally and confidently.

Ownership Mindset: You treat each client's business as if it were your own and take responsibility for outcomes.

  • You prefer to hide behind email and avoid client conversations.
  • You want to simply pass messages between clients and internal teams rather than own outcomes.
  • You are uncomfortable discussing performance, renewals, upsells, or challenging client conversations.
  • You need constant reminders to follow up, document next steps, or stay ahead of deadlines.
  • You don't enjoy helping small businesses understand marketing in a simple, confident way.

Skills & Experience Required

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, client success, or a client-facing digital marketing role.
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing, including paid advertising, SEO, social media, email, and landing pages.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing multiple client relationships or projects simultaneously.
  • Comfort reading campaign metrics and communicating performance results.
  • Proficiency with CRM and project management tools.
  • Reliable remote work setup and availability to work primarily on an Eastern Time schedule.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience in child care, education, franchise, or multi-location businesses.
  • Previous marketing agency experience.
  • Proven experience upselling or growing existing client accounts.
  • Google Ads and/or Meta advertising certifications.
  • Experience with GoHighLevel, ClickUp, or similar marketing platforms.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow through smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.

The Opportunity

You'll be responsible for driving strategic outbound pipeline development, identifying high-value opportunities, and initiating contact with potential enterprise customers through sophisticated, multi-channel outbound campaigns. Rather than conducting traditional cold outreach from absolute zero, you will tap into a massive community of "open-source curious" prospects and active community users, leveraging their familiarity with MariaDB to initiate enterprise-grade conversations.

Throughout your conversations, you will map complex corporate structures, multi-thread across strategic accounts, detect deep customer pain points, and help these organizations understand how MariaDB’s enterprise solutions can solve their mission-critical data challenges. As part of our Product Advisors team, you will play a critical role in our growth by executing a rigorous outbound prospecting motion that directly builds pipeline and supports our Enterprise Sales team. MariaDB has a consistent track record of promoting from within, and we are looking for candidates who are excited about advancing their sales careers by revolutionizing the way data is stored and accessed.

What You'll Do:

  • Strategic Account Mapping: Identify high-potential enterprise businesses and map complex corporate structures to identify key decision-makers who fit the MariaDB ideal customer profile.
  • Enterprise Multi-Threading: Develop and execute rigorous territory plans using advanced outbound prospecting methodologies (phone, email, and social) to multi-thread across both technical and business stakeholders within strategic accounts.
  • Community-Led Outbound Motion: Leverage open-source community interest, product downloads, and digital footprints to turn existing brand warmth into qualified enterprise sales cycles.
  • Campaign Development & Alignment: Partner closely with the Marketing and Enterprise Sales teams to design, execute, and lead account-based outbound campaigns from initial strategy through to qualified transition.
  • Complex Discovery: Schedule and facilitate high-level sales discovery calls, ensuring a seamless, deeply qualified handoff of prospects to Enterprise Sales Account Executives.
  • Navigate Enterprise Orgs: Confidently interact with, engage, and influence senior IT leadership, architecture teams, and business decision-makers.
  • Nurture & Build: Actively nurture early-phase enterprise opportunities, guiding community users toward the value of enterprise-grade support, scale, performance, and security.
  • Data Hygiene: Meticulously update, track, and manage all lead and prospect activity in Salesforce and Salesloft to ensure flawless pipeline visibility.
  • Exceed Targets: Consistently hit and exceed monthly and quarterly outbound opportunity quotas.

What You'll Need:

  • Experience: 2–4 years of dedicated B2B Business Development or outbound prospecting experience, with a proven focus on mapping and targeting enterprise accounts.
  • Education: BA/BS degree.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is required.
  • Communication: Outstanding active listening, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to hold peer-level conversations with technical executives and developers.
  • Drive: A self-starter mentality with a demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding pipeline generation goals.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp time management skills and the ability to operate independently within a structured outbound motion, while remaining highly coachable.
  • Adaptability: Desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth enterprise tech environment.
  • Tech Savvy: Passionate about cutting-edge database technology, with a high aptitude for quickly learning complex IT software products and business-critical solutions.

Location: Remote - Malaysia

What’s in It for You?

Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB. Be part of a game-changing organization that encourages outside-the-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry.

You’ll be collaborating with high-caliber colleagues around the world, offering unparalleled learning and growth opportunities. We provide a very competitive compensation package, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays), a massive degree of flexibility and freedom, and more.

How to Apply

  • If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your resume/CV through our ATS Greenhouse.
  • MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
  • MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  • MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for any unsolicited resumes.
  • MariaDB is an equal opportunities employer

Recruiter – Remote

Talent Acquisition | Full-Cycle Recruiting | Candidate Sourcing | Interviewing

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (flexibility for interviews and candidate coordination)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Recruiter to manage the full recruitment lifecycle—from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews, managing offers, and supporting onboarding.

This is a fast-paced, execution-focused recruiting role where you’ll partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and hire top talent across multiple industries and functions.

You’ll own:

  • Full-cycle recruiting
  • Candidate sourcing
  • Pipeline management
  • Interview coordination
  • Candidate experience
  • Hiring manager communication
  • Offer management

If you’re passionate about finding exceptional talent, building strong candidate pipelines, and delivering an outstanding hiring experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage the hiring process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand:
    • Hiring needs
    • Role requirements
    • Success profiles
    • Hiring timelines
  • Create and optimize job descriptions to maximize candidate attraction across multiple platforms.
  • Provide hiring managers with market insights and recruiting recommendations.

Candidate Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development

  • Source candidates using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Indeed
    • Glassdoor
    • Boolean Search
    • Niche job boards
  • Build pipelines of both active and passive candidates.
  • Conduct personalized outreach campaigns.
  • Perform talent mapping and market research.
  • Maintain healthy pipelines across multiple open positions.

Candidate Screening & Interviewing

  • Conduct structured phone and video interviews.
  • Evaluate candidates based on:
    • Experience
    • Communication
    • Technical skills
    • Cultural alignment
    • Career goals
  • Utilize competency-based and behavioral interviewing techniques.
  • Administer assessments when required.
  • Maintain detailed interview notes within the ATS.

Candidate Experience & Communication

  • Manage communication throughout the hiring process.
  • Ensure candidates receive:
    • Timely updates
    • Interview preparation
    • Professional follow-up
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first contact through offer acceptance.
  • Represent both the client and employer brand professionally.

Interview Coordination & Hiring Support

  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones.
  • Prepare candidates before interviews.
  • Facilitate hiring feedback and interview debriefs.
  • Support hiring managers with structured candidate recommendations.

Offer Management & Onboarding Support

  • Prepare and present employment offers.
  • Support compensation discussions and offer negotiations.
  • Coordinate onboarding documentation and hiring logistics.
  • Ensure smooth transitions into onboarding.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS records and recruiting documentation.
  • Track recruiting metrics including:
    • Time-to-fill
    • Pipeline health
    • Source effectiveness
    • Candidate conversion rates
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes and hiring efficiency.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Recruiting
    • Talent Acquisition
    • Staffing
    • Headhunting
  • Experience managing full-cycle recruiting.
  • Hands-on experience with ATS platforms such as:
    • Greenhouse
    • Lever
    • JazzHR
    • iCIMS
  • Strong sourcing experience using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Boolean Search
    • Job boards
  • Excellent interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple hiring pipelines simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Agency recruiting or staffing experience.
  • High-volume recruiting experience.
  • Experience hiring for:
    • SaaS
    • Finance
    • Professional Services
    • Property Management
    • Operations
  • Knowledge of recruiting compliance and employment practices.
  • Experience scaling recruiting operations and talent pipelines.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder.
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-through.
  • Comfortable managing multiple open roles simultaneously.
  • Metrics-driven and process-oriented.
  • Able to balance hiring speed with candidate quality.
  • Proactive, responsive, and solutions-focused.
  • Passionate about creating outstanding candidate experiences.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Source candidates across LinkedIn and job boards.
  • Review resumes and conduct recruiter phone screens.
  • Schedule interviews with hiring managers.
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process.
  • Update ATS records and recruiting pipelines.
  • Provide hiring managers with recruiting updates and market feedback.
  • Track recruiting metrics and sourcing performance.

In short: You build strong talent pipelines, deliver an exceptional candidate experience, and keep hiring processes moving efficiently from sourcing through offer acceptance.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time-to-fill
  • Candidate quality and interview progression rates
  • Hiring manager satisfaction
  • Candidate experience and responsiveness
  • ATS accuracy and compliance
  • Pipeline health
  • Sourcing effectiveness

Why Join Us?

  • Full ownership of the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Opportunity to recruit across multiple industries and functions.
  • Fast-paced, high-impact recruiting environment.
  • Direct exposure to clients and hiring leaders.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Recruiter
    • Talent Acquisition Partner
    • Recruiting Lead
    • Recruiting Manager
    • People Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Sourcing Task (Boolean Search & Candidate Sourcing Exercise)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you enjoy sourcing exceptional talent, thrive in fast-paced hiring environments, excel at building strong candidate relationships, and take pride in delivering an outstanding recruitment experience, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help connect great talent with great opportunities.
