jobs.excerpt: SummaryThe Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to support and develop the platform serving the world’s favorite encyclopedia, Wikipedia, to millions of people around the globe.
jobs.description:
Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to support and develop the platform serving the world’s favorite encyclopedia, Wikipedia, to millions of people around the globe. Wikimedia’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is principally responsible for ensuring our global top-10 website and its underlying infrastructure is healthy and developing further in support of Wikimedia’s mission: to help everyone share in the sum of all knowledge.

The SRE team at Wikimedia is a globally distributed and diverse team of engineers with a drive to explore, experiment, and embrace new technologies. We work in the open by publishing all of our documentation, code, and configuration as open source, and all our production systems are powered by open source software. We invite you to go through our documentation and code -- no login required.

If you find what we do interesting, if you are up to the challenge of improving the reliability and delivery of one of the Internet’s top websites, and you enjoy the idea of working in a remote-first role, we may just be the right place for you.

You are responsible for:

  • Performing day-to-day operational/DevOps tasks on Wikimedia’s public facing infrastructure (deployment, maintenance, configuration, troubleshooting)
  • Implementing and utilizing configuration management and deployment tools (Puppet, Kubernetes)
  • Leading continuous improvement, by automating the installation, configuration and maintenance of services on our platform
  • Work closely with product teams helping them bring scalable functionality to our users by assisting in the architectural design of new services and making them operate at scale
  • Participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation shared across the broader SRE team. This includes taking part in incident response, diagnosis and follow-up on system outages or alerts across Wikimedia’s production infrastructure.
  • Collaborating with a global, cross-functional team in an asynchronous communication environment
  • Mentoring peers in your areas of technical and operational strength
  • Ability and willingness to travel 1-2 times a year for in-person events and team meetings

Most importantly, share our values and work in accordance with them

Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in an SRE/Operations/DevOps role as part of a team
  • Experience with shell and any scripting languages used in an SRE context (Python, Go, Bash, Ruby; we primarily use Python) and configuration management tools (Puppet, Ansible; we use Puppet)
  • Experience designing and managing infrastructure security for large fleets of diverse services
  • Experience with technical response during security incidents
  • Experience with package management on Linux systems (we use Debian)
  • Strong Linux system-level troubleshooting skills
  • History of automating tasks and processes, identifying process gaps, and finding automation opportunities
  • Strong English language skills (verbal and written) and ability to work independently, as an effective part of a globally distributed team working across multiple time zones
  • Experience leading and participating in incident response and post-incident review rituals, with the goal of conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures

Additionally, we’d love it if you have:

  • Experience setting and implementing fleet-wide security policies
  • Experience with software supply chain security
  • Awareness of the current open source infrastructure security landscape
  • Experience working together with software security teams
  • Experience with credential management systems
  • Experience implementing immutable logging and auditing
  • Experience with the use, maintenance and configuration of monitoring, metrics and logging infrastructure (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.)
  • Developing/contributing to Free and Open Source software, or being part of an open-source community (share your favourite pull requests!)
  • Experience with LAMP stack technologies (PHP/HHVM, memcached/Redis) -- MediaWiki experience is a definite plus
  • Experience with defining cross-team SLOs and their implementation

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

jobs.description:
What Makes Us Stand Out:

Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers. Granum brings together three of the most trusted software names in the industry — LMN, SingleOps, and Greenius — into one powerful software ecosystem. More than just a software company, Granum works alongside its clients to implement systems for estimating, scheduling, crew training, invoicing, and payments, blending technology with hands-on onboarding and human support. The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients’ success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we’re on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we’re looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness. If this resonates with you, we’d love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it’s a great time to join!

  • Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams
  • Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees
  • #9 Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Best Places to Work (Our second year in a row!)
  • #6 of Built In’s 2024 Best Places to Work: Top 50 start-ups in Atlanta (Our second year in a row!)
  • Inc Magazine’s 2023 Best Places to Work
  • Inc. 5000: #131 of 2024 Southeast Regional America’s Fastest Growing Companies. (Our third year in a row!)
  • Inc 5000 America's fastest-growing private companies (Our third year in a row!)
  • Certified Great Place to Work Canada 2024

The Market Engagement Associate is the frontline of our inbound funnel. You turn qualified interest into high‑quality sales conversations by responding quickly to inbound leads, deeply understanding their pains, and booking demos that are set up to convert. This role sits at the bridge between Marketing and Sales, ensuring that campaign demand becomes pipeline and revenue, not just “leads in a spreadsheet.”

You’ll thrive here if you like fast-paced, high-volume work, talking to customers every day, and using data and experimentation to continuously improve.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Response & Qualification

  • Respond to inbound leads quickly across channels (forms, chat, events, content downloads), meeting speed‑to‑lead SLAs.

  • Qualify prospects using light discovery (problems, goals, timing, fit) and align them to the right product, tier, and sales resource.

  • Prioritize daily lead queues by intent level, source, and recency to maximize connect and conversion rates.

  • Maintain clean, accurate records of every interaction, disposition, and next step in the CRM.

Demo Booking & Pipeline Creation

  • Book high‑quality demos for Sales with clear expectations set for both the prospect and the rep.

  • Confirm meetings (time, attendees, agenda) and reinforce value to drive strong demo show rates.

  • Re‑engage no‑shows and stalled inbound leads with thoughtful outreach sequences and incentives when appropriate (e.g. webinar and partner follow‑ups).

  • Partner closely with Sales to ensure smooth handoffs and feedback loops on lead quality and conversion.

Nurture & Campaign Support

  • Work lead lists from priority campaigns (webinars, paid social, events, product launches) to turn engagement into booked meetings.

  • Support “reactivation” and re‑engagement motions for older inbound leads that match our ICP.

  • Tailor talk tracks and messaging by persona, segment, and product line to increase connection and conversion.

  • Share frontline insights about objections, competitors, and common pain points back to Marketing for messaging and campaign refinement.

Process, Data, & Continuous Improvement

  • Consistently follow documented workflows, cadences, and qualification criteria across tools.

  • Monitor your own performance (connect rate, meetings set, show rate, conversion to opportunity) and adjust your approach based on what’s working.

  • Test new messaging, sequences, and touch patterns; share results so the team can scale winning plays.

  • Provide regular feedback on lead sources, campaign outcomes, and routing logic to Marketing, RevOps, and Sales leadership.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is measured by both volume and quality:

  • Speed‑to‑Lead:

    • First contact attempt within 5 minutes for top‑priority inbound leads.

  • Activity & Coverage:

    • Daily/weekly targets for calls, emails, and sequences consistently met while maintaining process hygiene.

  • Conversion Metrics:

    • Meetings booked and SALs (Sales Accepted Leads) at or above goal.

    • Demo show rate consistently in the target band (e.g., 60–80%+).

    • Healthy conversion from meeting → opportunity in partnership with Sales.

  • Data Quality:

    • High CRM and sequence hygiene: accurate dispositions, notes, and next steps.

  • Collaboration & Feedback:

    • Recognized by Sales and Marketing as a reliable, proactive partner who surfaces insights and helps improve the entire funnel.

Qualifications

Must‑Have:

  • 1–3 years in a customer-facing or revenue‑adjacent role (SDR/BDR, inbound sales, support, success, or similar).

  • Clear, confident verbal and written communication; comfortable on the phone, email and video.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize a high volume of inbound leads.

  • Experience working in a CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Hubspot) and at least one sales engagement or marketing automation tool (E.g Outreach).

  • Data‑aware mindset: you regularly look at your own metrics and adjust based on performance.

  • Curiosity and empathy — you ask smart questions, listen actively, and care about whether we’re truly a fit for the prospect.

  • Comfort and passion for adopting AI tools to draft outreach, summarize calls, or optimize workflows.

Nice‑to‑Have:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS and/or working with SMB / mid‑market customers.

  • Familiarity with inbound marketing funnels and concepts like MQL, SAL, SQL, show rate, and speed‑to‑lead.

  • Experience partnering closely with both Marketing and Sales teams.

Tools You’ll Use

(Exact stack may vary by company.)

  • CRM: Salesforce and Hubspot for lead, account, and opportunity management.

  • Sales Prospecting: Outreach, or equivalent for sequences and task queues.

  • Marketing / Automation: HubSpot for understanding lead source and behavior.

  • Scheduling & Routing: Chili Piper or equivalent for demo booking and routing.

  • Gifting / Incentives: Sendoso or similar to support re‑engagement and show‑rate campaigns.

  • Communication: Zoom/Teams, email, phone, and chat for customer interactions.

  • AI & Productivity: Tools like Glean/Claude to accelerate research, drafting, and analysis.

Why This Role Matters

Market Engagement is where marketing investment turns into real pipeline. As a Market Engagement Associate, you are often the first human conversation a prospect has with our company. The quality, clarity, and care you bring to those interactions directly impact our revenue, our reputation, and whether prospects become long‑term customers.

Compensation

  • Estimated pay range for Canada-based candidates: CAD 45,000 - 55,000 base + $20,000 OTE

  • Estimated pay range for US-based candidates: USD 45,000 - 55,000 base + 30,000 OTE

Reasons why you would love it here!

  • Join a team culture that’s all about collaboration, support, and having fun while making a real impact every day.
  • In the U.S., we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options, plus additional add ons like HSA/FSA accounts, disability and life insurance, and more.
  • In Canada, we provide an employer-funded HSA-based benefits plan with drug, dental, and mental health coverage - giving you a flexible way to manage your healthcare needs.
  • We're committed to your financial future, with 401(k) matching for U.S. employees and RRSP matching for those in Canada.
  • We invest in your growth through tailored career development conversations and support for tools, courses, and resources to help you thrive.
  • And when it comes to work-life balance? We offer unlimited Paid Time Off, paid company holidays, and a company-wide winter break from December 24 to January 1 - so you can truly recharge.

Granum does not sponsor work authorization needs; candidates must have proper work authorization to work for any employer in Canada or the U.S, without sponsorship from the company.

jobs.excerpt: Company SummaryLearning Network is a growing, innovative, and customer-centric educational services company.
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Learning Network is a growing, innovative, and customer-centric educational services company. We seek creative and tenacious individuals to help us drive success through service.

Service is very important to us. At Learning Network, you will be among people who care about their customers and colleagues. We prioritize service by ensuring the details are done and done well - every time. We make promises, and we keep those promises. We recognize that our customers and employees don’t have to choose us. As such, service is embedded deep within our culture - and providing white-glove service is an expectation of every employee.

At Learning Network, you’ll be a part of something special. You’ll sleep better knowing you make a difference by bringing the most innovative education to thousands of students. You’ll do this amongst a supportive community of people who care. In return, you’ll care. You’ll show you care by being teachable, doing your job well, and valuing the relationships with your colleagues. You’ll achieve your goals and play nicely in the sandbox with others while doing it. We don’t do drama, and neither should you.

Working at Learning Network isn’t for everyone. But for those who choose to commit to hard work, service, students, and colleagues, it’s an incredibly rewarding experience.

Impact & Why This Matters

In a world where too many students feel unseen, disconnected, or left behind—whether due to distance, circumstance, or doubt—you will be their consistent champion.

Every proactive outreach, personalized video feedback, and timely intervention has the power to restore belief, spark 'I can do this' moments, accelerate mastery, and set a young person on a trajectory toward post-high school success, meaningful careers, and purposeful lives—whether through college, skilled trades, certifications, apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, or other paths that align with their unique strengths and dreams.

This isn’t routine teaching. It's legacy-building in the digital age: redefining what’s possible in education by delivering white-glove, heart-centered support that reaches students anywhere and empowers them to own their futures—one empowered learner at a time.

Purpose

You will be the daily force that ignites curiosity, rebuilds confidence, and unlocks lifelong potential in every student. You will find ways to open doors for students. You will champion personalized success through relentless engagement, clear guidance, and unwavering belief—delivering transformative, white-glove service that changes trajectories for students and families alike.

Role Overview

This is a deeply student-facing, relationship-driven role where your impact hinges on daily human connection. You'll reach out consistently via phone, text, chat, Zoom, and email while guiding learners through a powerful, structured curriculum.

Your success is measured in both key performance indicators like engagement rates and on-pace progress and in lives changed: students who re-engage after setbacks, gain confidence through meaningful feedback, stay on pace toward graduation, and emerge more resilient and capable.

It demands extreme ownership, lightning responsiveness, and joyful persistence because when you show up fully, students feel seen, valued, and unstoppable.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build unbreakable daily connections that keep students motivated, seen, and soaring, turning potential drop-offs into breakthroughs through caring, proactive outreach.
  • Guide learners through the curriculum with clarity and passion, reinforcing key concepts and helping them master material.
  • Monitor engagement and progress with eagle-eyed attention; spot struggling or disengaged students early and launch timely, personalized interventions that reignite momentum.
  • Deliver timely grading and powerful, meaningful feedback that reinforces learning, celebrates growth, builds self-efficacy, and equips students to conquer challenges with confidence.

Essential Duties

  1. Serve students, families, and colleagues with genuine professionalism, integrity, humility, and a white-glove mindset that makes every interaction feel personal and uplifting.
  2. Own daily monitoring of student engagement and academic progress; act swiftly and thoughtfully when support is needed most.
  3. Foster genuine relationships through consistent, reliable, multi-channel communication that makes students and families feel supported all day, every school day.
  4. Empower mastery of course material by guiding students with clarity, varied explanations, and encouragement that sparks deeper understanding.
  5. Provide prompt, high-quality grading and feedback that inspires forward movement and long-term growth.
  6. Keep precise, actionable records of progress and interventions to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  7. Collaborate enthusiastically with peers and leaders to amplify student success across the team.
  8. Engage fully in professional development, meetings, and training to continuously elevate your impact.
  9. Teach faithfully within the assigned curriculum, pacing, and resources only, channeling your creativity into masterful delivery rather than any creation from scratch or use of outside materials.
  10. Lead live sessions when called upon, bringing energy and connection using only provided content.
  11. Support proctoring during testing windows, including occasional travel, to ensure fair and secure assessments.
  12. Embrace other duties as needed to advance our mission.

Work Schedule and Availability

  1. Work a fixed schedule: 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Mountain Time (Denver/America), year-round, auto-adjusting for daylight saving time.
  2. Work full time in this exempt role, requiring at least 40 hours per week with uninterrupted focus during scheduled hours.
  3. Remain actively available and immediately responsive throughout the workday via phone, chat, Zoom, email, and internal systems so students, parents, and colleagues can reach you in real time.
  4. Avoid all concurrent work during scheduled hours and maintain full professional focus; ensure any outside employment does not interfere with performance and is approved in writing in advance.
  5. Maintain a private, professional, distraction-free remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet that supports video and required tools.
  6. Maintain consistent daily availability; absences exceeding two consecutive instructional days materially disrupt student support, engagement, and progress monitoring and generally cannot be accommodated during the instructional term.

This Role Is Your Calling If:

  • You wake up energized by the chance to be a consistent, believing adult in a student's life—especially when the world feels overwhelming.
  • You thrive on forging real relationships that spark "aha" moments, rebuild confidence, and drive lasting growth.
  • You're wired for excellence: self-driven, ultra-responsive, and proud to own every student's progress as if it were your own family member.
  • You see online education as a superpower—reaching underserved students anywhere, personalizing at scale, and redefining access to transformative learning.
  • You embrace clear structure, metrics, and accountability because they fuel your ability to deliver extraordinary results.

This Role May Not Align If:

  • You seek high flexibility in your schedule or a self-paced workday.
  • You prefer minimal direct interaction with students or parents.
  • You dislike proactive outreach such as phone calls or frequent messaging.
  • You expect primarily asynchronous teaching with limited real-time engagement.
  • You struggle with tight responsiveness, follow-through, or time management under metrics.
  • You want to balance this position with another job.
  • You resist oversight, performance tracking, or structured expectations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  1. Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally.
  2. Ability to build rapport, gain commitment, and explain concepts using varied methods.
  3. Extreme ownership of outcomes with high self-motivation, discipline, and accountability to exceed expectations.
  4. Proven content knowledge and prior educational success with students from a variety of backgrounds.
  5. Strong organizational skills, time management, attention to detail, and the ability to handle competing priorities.
  6. Independent work capability paired with effective remote team collaboration.
  7. Proficiency with Mac OS, Google Workspace, learning management systems, and task tools (e.g., Asana); quick adaptation to new technologies.
  8. Willingness and ability to travel to assigned testing locations for proctoring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education or related field (required)
  • Teacher certification and an approved teacher preparation program (required)
  • Ability to obtain certifications in Arizona, Colorado, Washington, and other states as may be assigned (required)
  • 3+ years teaching experience (preferred)
  • 2+ years online teaching experience (preferred)
  • Ability to pass required background checks (required)

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision employee coverage for as little as $1 each per month;
  • Personal paid time off in addition to major holidays;
  • Short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and AD&D insurance are all 100% paid by the employer; and
  • 401(k) with employer contributing a dollar-for-dollar match of employee contributions up to 6% of employee earnings.
Base Pay Range
$50,000—$55,000 USD

jobs.description:
Tax Specialist – U.S. Tax Preparation & Compliance

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility during tax season and filing deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Tax Specialist to manage U.S. tax preparation, compliance, filings, and tax planning support for individuals and businesses.

This is a hands-on tax role requiring strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state taxation, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple filings and deadlines accurately.

You’ll prepare and review individual, corporate, and partnership tax returns, monitor regulatory requirements, respond to tax notices, support audits, and identify legitimate opportunities to reduce tax liabilities.

The ideal candidate has 3+ years of U.S. tax experience, hands-on experience with professional tax preparation software, and a strong understanding of IRS filing requirements.

What You’ll Own

U.S. Tax Preparation & Filing

  • Prepare and review U.S. federal and state tax returns.
  • Handle returns including:
    • Form 1040 – Individual Income Tax Returns
    • Form 1120 – Corporate Income Tax Returns
    • Form 1065 – Partnership Returns
  • Prepare quarterly estimated tax payments.
  • Prepare and file extensions when required.
  • Review supporting financial information for completeness and accuracy.
  • Ensure returns are submitted accurately and within applicable deadlines.
  • Maintain supporting schedules and workpapers for completed filings.

Federal, State & Local Tax Compliance

  • Monitor changes to U.S. tax laws, regulations, and IRS guidance.
  • Maintain compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements.
  • Support multi-state tax compliance and filings.
  • Assist with:
    • Sales tax
    • Payroll tax
    • Property tax
  • Track filing calendars and ensure deadlines are not missed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation supporting tax positions and calculations.

Tax Planning & Advisory Support

  • Identify applicable deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities.
  • Support tax planning for individuals and businesses.
  • Analyze financial information to identify potential tax efficiencies.
  • Advise on tax implications of business transactions and financial decisions.
  • Help clients understand tax obligations and planning opportunities.
  • Support tax planning for closely held businesses and high-net-worth individuals where applicable.

Tax Notices & Audit Support

  • Review and respond to IRS and state tax notices.
  • Gather supporting documentation for tax audits and inquiries.
  • Prepare organized schedules and records for auditors and tax authorities.
  • Research discrepancies and assist with resolving tax-related issues.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready tax documentation.

International Tax Support

Where applicable, support international tax matters including:

  • FBAR
  • FATCA
  • Transfer pricing considerations
  • International reporting requirements

International tax experience is preferred but not required.

Accounting & Finance Collaboration

  • Work closely with accounting and finance teams during month-end and year-end close.
  • Review financial records to ensure tax reporting aligns with accounting data.
  • Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, and tax advisors when required.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent financial information before filing.
  • Communicate tax implications clearly to finance teams and business stakeholders.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain updated tax compliance SOPs.
  • Document tax positions, assumptions, and filing methodologies.
  • Maintain organized client tax records and supporting documentation.
  • Improve tax preparation and review workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to increase accuracy and efficiency during high-volume filing periods.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional U.S. tax preparation and compliance experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing individual and business tax returns.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Form 1040
    • Form 1120
    • Form 1065
  • Experience with IRS e-filing systems and state tax portals.
  • Strong understanding of tax deadlines, estimated payments, and extensions.
  • Ability to research and interpret tax regulations.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tax filings and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. client business hours.

Tax Software

Hands-on experience with one or more professional tax platforms such as:

  • UltraTax
  • Lacerte
  • ProSeries
  • Drake Tax
  • Equivalent professional tax preparation software

Excel & Google Sheets

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for:

  • Tax reconciliations
  • Supporting schedules
  • Financial analysis
  • Data organization
  • Reporting
  • Tax workpapers

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • CPA designation.
  • Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.
  • Master’s degree in Taxation.
  • Multi-state tax experience.
  • International tax exposure.
  • Experience with FBAR/FATCA or transfer pricing.
  • Experience supporting high-net-worth individuals.
  • Experience working with closely held businesses.
  • Background supporting clients in:
    • Professional services
    • SaaS
    • Real estate
  • Experience working within a CPA, tax, accounting, or professional services firm.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Understand U.S. tax preparation beyond basic data entry.
  • Are highly accurate and detail-oriented.
  • Stay organized when managing multiple clients and deadlines.
  • Can interpret tax rules and explain their practical implications clearly.
  • Proactively identify potential compliance issues.
  • Remain dependable during high-volume tax periods.
  • Maintain organized workpapers and supporting documentation.
  • Take ownership of filings from preparation through submission and follow-up.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing upcoming federal and state filing deadlines.
  • Preparing individual, corporate, or partnership tax returns.
  • Reviewing financial records and supporting schedules.
  • Identifying applicable deductions and credits.
  • Preparing estimated tax payments or extensions.
  • Researching federal or state tax requirements.
  • Responding to IRS or state notices.
  • Reconciling tax schedules against accounting records.
  • Coordinating with accounting teams, CPAs, or clients.
  • Documenting tax positions and maintaining audit-ready records.
  • Reviewing completed returns for accuracy before filing.

In short: you ensure tax filings are accurate, compliant, timely, and supported by organized documentation while helping identify legitimate opportunities for tax efficiency.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 100% of tax filings completed accurately and on time.
  • Zero avoidable compliance penalties or missed deadlines.
  • Accurate and complete tax workpapers.
  • Timely resolution of IRS and state notices.
  • Organized, audit-ready tax documentation.
  • Strong client and leadership satisfaction.
  • Identification of applicable tax-saving opportunities.
  • Consistent execution during high-volume filing periods.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership across U.S. tax preparation and compliance.
  • Exposure to both individual and business taxation.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise across federal and multi-state tax matters.
  • Direct collaboration with finance, accounting, and tax leadership.
  • Exposure to tax planning and advisory work beyond return preparation.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Strong potential for growth into:
    • Senior Tax Specialist
    • Tax Manager
    • Tax Advisor
    • Tax Operations Lead

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience preparing U.S. federal and state tax returns.
  • Which returns you have personally prepared, particularly Forms 1040, 1120, and 1065.

  • Any experience you have with sales tax, payroll tax, or property tax filings.
  • Any exposure to high-net-worth, closely held business, or international tax matters.
  • How you review your work to ensure accuracy before a return is filed.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We’re particularly interested in your hands-on U.S. tax experience, technical knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to communicate tax matters clearly.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Tax Assessment
  • Client Interview with Finance/Tax Leadership
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong U.S. tax preparation and compliance experience, are comfortable preparing individual and business returns, and take pride in accurate, deadline-driven work, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and high-performing Business Development Manager – Subscription Sales to drive new business growth across the US and European markets.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in end-to-end B2B sales, with strong experience in subscription-based sales, consultative selling, and new client acquisition. This is a hunter-focused role requiring an established network of clients and prospects, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle—from prospecting and relationship building to negotiation and closure.

You will be responsible for expanding Frost & Sullivan's client base, developing strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, and driving revenue through our subscription-based research, advisory, and consulting solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle across the US and European markets, from prospecting and lead generation through negotiation and closure.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within target industries and accounts.
  • Leverage an established client and prospect network to generate qualified opportunities and accelerate pipeline growth.
  • Drive subscription sales by understanding client business challenges and positioning relevant Frost & Sullivan research and advisory solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior decision-makers and C-suite stakeholders across target accounts.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities, industry trends, and market dynamics to deliver a consultative sales approach.
  • Conduct discovery meetings, presentations, solution discussions, commercial negotiations, and contract closures.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue, subscription, pipeline, and new-logo acquisition targets.
  • Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline across assigned geographies and industries.
  • Prepare compelling proposals, commercial presentations, and business cases tailored to client requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with research, consulting, and delivery teams to ensure solutions are aligned with client objectives.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity, activity, and forecast information in CRM systems.
  • Monitor market developments and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities and strengthen the sales strategy.
  • Contribute to account and territory strategies to support sustained revenue growth.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred.
  • 5–12 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, consultative sales, or subscription sales.
  • Demonstrated success in new business acquisition and hunter-led sales environments.
  • Strong experience selling to clients in the US and European markets.
  • Proven track record of managing the complete sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.
  • Prior experience selling subscription-based products, research, intelligence, advisory, consulting, SaaS, or information services is highly preferred.
  • Strong and demonstrable existing client/prospect network across the US and/or Europe.
  • Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and decision-makers, including C-suite executives.
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding revenue and sales targets.
  • Excellent consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify client needs and translate them into business value.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage pipeline, forecasting, and sales activities.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a target-driven, fast-paced global environment.

Required Competencies

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated strength in:

  • Hunter / New Business Development
  • Subscription Sales
  • End-to-End Sales Cycle Management
  • Consultative & Solution Selling
  • Proven success selling into the US, Europe, and APAC markets with an understanding of regional buying behaviour
  • Strategic Account Development
  • Senior Stakeholder & C-Suite Engagement
  • Pipeline & Forecast Management
  • Commercial Negotiation
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Market & Industry Understanding

What Will Make You Succeed at Frost & Sullivan?

You need to be:

  • Wildly curious and entrepreneurial – constantly looking for new opportunities and ways to create value.
  • Commercially driven – motivated by ambitious revenue targets and new business growth.
  • Committed to customer success – focused on understanding client challenges and delivering meaningful outcomes.
  • A self-starter – comfortable owning your territory, pipeline, and sales outcomes.
  • A persuasive communicator – confident engaging with senior stakeholders and influencing buying decisions.
  • Deeply analytical – able to connect market trends and business challenges to relevant solutions.
  • Relationship-oriented – capable of building trusted, long-term relationships with clients.
  • Excited about disruptive trends – passionate about innovation, emerging technologies, and transformational growth.

Benefits

  • A friendly work environment with an open-door policy
  • Strong career path and growth opportunities
  • Opportunity to work as part of a global team that strives for excellence and fosters an Olympic spirit
  • Collaboration with colleagues and senior leaders across geographies and functions
  • Global recognition through President's Club and Chairman's Club Awards
  • Continuous learning, coaching, and professional development
  • Flexible work policy
  • Attractive medical and accident insurance

About Frost & Sullivan

Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 60 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets, and new business models.

Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate not only to survive but to thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth.

This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global change by innovating to zero.

jobs.excerpt: Payroll Accountant – RemotePayroll | Accounting | U.
jobs.description:
Payroll Accountant – Remote

Payroll | Accounting | U.S. Payroll Compliance | Financial Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Payroll Accountant to manage end-to-end payroll operations while ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with U.S. payroll regulations.

This is a highly detail-oriented role that combines payroll processing, accounting, tax compliance, reconciliations, and financial reporting. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate payroll records, integrating payroll with accounting systems, resolving discrepancies, and supporting audits while ensuring compliance across all payroll processes.

The ideal candidate has strong payroll expertise, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to manage confidential information with accuracy and professionalism.

What You’ll Own

Payroll Processing

  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls for organizations ranging from 50–500 employees.
  • Validate employee time entries, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and deductions prior to payroll processing.
  • Administer payroll using platforms such as ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, BambooHR, or similar systems.
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately and delivered on schedule.

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Record payroll journal entries within accounting systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero.
  • Reconcile payroll clearing accounts and payroll-related bank transactions.
  • Record employer contributions, benefit deductions, and payroll liabilities accurately.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies promptly.

Payroll Tax & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit federal, state, and local payroll tax payments.
  • File payroll tax forms including 941, W-2, 1099, and applicable state filings.
  • Monitor changes in payroll tax laws and labor regulations.
  • Ensure payroll processes remain compliant and audit-ready.

Benefits Administration

  • Reconcile healthcare, retirement, and employee benefit contributions.
  • Verify employee deductions align with benefit elections.
  • Coordinate with benefit providers regarding payroll-related discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate payroll deduction records.

Employee Payroll Support

  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries regarding paychecks, direct deposits, tax withholding, and payroll documentation.
  • Support payroll setup for new hires and employee updates.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling employee information.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare recurring payroll, headcount, and labor cost reports.
  • Support audits with organized payroll documentation.
  • Perform payroll variance analysis against budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide payroll insights to finance and HR leadership.

Process Improvement

  • Improve payroll workflows using Excel automation, payroll integrations, or APIs.
  • Develop and maintain payroll SOPs and documentation.
  • Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce errors.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of payroll processing experience.
  • Hands-on experience using at least one payroll platform such as ADP, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, Gusto, or BambooHR.
  • Experience supporting payroll accounting and reconciliations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations).
  • Strong understanding of payroll accounting principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality.

Nice-to-Have

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).
  • Multi-state or international payroll experience.
  • Experience reconciling payroll with accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations including BambooHR, Zenefits, or Workday.
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance reviews.

Tools & Platforms

  • ADP
  • Paychex
  • Gusto
  • QuickBooks Payroll
  • BambooHR
  • QuickBooks
  • NetSuite
  • Xero
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional numerical accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance and accounting processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot discrepancies under tight deadlines.
  • Professional and discreet when handling confidential information.
  • Organized with strong documentation habits.
  • Proactive in identifying process improvements and ensuring compliance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review employee timecards and payroll changes.
  • Process payroll and verify payroll accuracy.
  • Reconcile payroll accounts and journal entries.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries.
  • File payroll tax payments and maintain compliance.
  • Reconcile employee benefit deductions.
  • Prepare payroll reports and financial summaries.
  • Update payroll documentation and SOPs.

In short: You ensure payroll is processed accurately, accounting records remain balanced, employees are paid on time, and payroll operations stay compliant with all applicable regulations.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • 100% on-time payroll processing
  • Payroll error rate below 1%
  • Timely payroll tax filings
  • Payroll discrepancies resolved within two business days
  • Accuracy of payroll reconciliations and journal entries
  • Audit readiness and compliance standards maintained

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based organizations.
  • High-impact role within finance and accounting operations.
  • Exposure to payroll, tax compliance, HR, and financial reporting.
  • Opportunity to improve payroll systems and operational efficiency.
  • Career growth into Senior Payroll Accountant, Payroll Manager, or Accounting leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Payroll Reconciliation & Discrepancy Resolution)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Payroll Accountant who enjoys ensuring accuracy, maintaining compliance, and supporting efficient payroll operations, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a growing finance team.

jobs.description:
Prominence Advisors is actively seeking a Manager of Analytics to join their team. You'll have the opportunity to help healthcare organizations solve their toughest challenges through your ability to drive strategic process improvement, manage complex projects, and solve difficult problems. You'll help strengthen our team of the best and brightest, with reputations centered on getting things done. We've won multiple awards for workplace culture and innovation, including our most recent designation as a top 10 Best Small Firm to work for by Consulting magazine.

At Prominence, you'll become part of a disruptive force in the Healthcare IT space, changing your clients' expectations for the better. Your clients will value you as a true advisor, filling a strategic need. You'll use honesty and candor to consistently provide straight-forward truths and conversations with clients.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare technology strategy and implementation firm, focused on helping the nation’s leading healthcare organizations to do more with their data. Founded by former Epic managers, we understand the technology landscape in healthcare and provide IT staffing, advisory services, and analytics solutions to create robust data ecosystems that support clinical workflows, automate operational processes, and expedite research. Whether it’s guiding a technology implementation, establishing governance principles, or developing leading edge analytics, we help our customers make sense out of the mountain of data at their fingertips in order to deliver higher quality care at a lower cost.

Ranked as a best place to work over 27 times (and counting!), Prominence’s culture provides consultants with a supportive environment that allows you to innovate and grow your career in healthcare IT. Additional information is available on our website.

Your Role

As a Manager of Analytics, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of reporting projects for different healthcare organizations. Your responsibilities will include gathering reporting requirements, designing and developing reports, conducting testing and validation, and providing post-implementation support. You will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the success of the reporting projects.

If you are a motivated professional with a passion for healthcare IT and Epic reporting, and you meet the requirements below, we encourage you to apply. If you know of someone else who would be a great fit, let us know!

Requirements

For this role you will need to possess the following qualifications:

  • Certifications
    • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), or similar professional certification preferred
  • Experience
    • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data product management, including experience leading analytics initiatives or teams
    • 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role within analytics, business intelligence, or data products
    • Demonstrated experience partnering with clinical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders to identify business needs and translate them into actionable analytics solutions
    • Experience defining and delivering analytics products based on customer problems, use cases, desired outcomes, adoption, and organizational value
    • Experience prioritizing analytics initiatives and competing stakeholder demands based on business impact and strategic value
    • Strong experience translating between technical analytics teams and nontechnical business and healthcare stakeholders
    • Demonstrated focus on adoption, usability, and measurable value of analytics products, beyond the delivery of dashboards and reports
    • Healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred, with an understanding of how clinical, operational, financial, and executive audiences use data to support decision-making
  • Role Focus & Responsibilities
    • Focused on analytics and data products
    • Strongly customer-centric orientation
    • Responsible for developing analytics/data products that address specific customer and business needs
    • Should be able to translate data and analytics capabilities into practical, customer-focused solutions
    • Part of the broader Data & AI organization, which operates across:
      • Data in Transit: EDI, APIs, integrations
      • Data at Rest: PACS and related data infrastructure
      • Data Products: Analytics-focused products designed around consumer/customer needs

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team!

You will own and evolve Mailtrap's production infrastructure — a multi-region AWS platform powering high-volume email sending and testing. You will keep it reliable, secure, and cost-efficient day to day.

You will also lead a key strategic initiative: planning and executing a partial migration of selected workloads from AWS to rented bare-metal / colocation infrastructure to cut costs — a hybrid-by-design effort, not a full cloud exit.

You will decide what moves and what stays, design the target platform (likely Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator on bare metal), and own the migration end to end, from business case to cutover.

Our engineering team thrives in an agile, continuously improving, and automation-oriented environment. We value ongoing evolution, objective evaluation of our processes, and taking action to make things better.

Must have skills

  • 5+ years DevOps/platform (senior), production ownership
  • Deep AWS (VPC, ECS, IAM, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents, networking)
  • Terraform at scale (modules, remote state / Terraform Cloud)
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including automated deploys to production (e.g. blue/green deployments)
  • Containers (Docker); comfortable operating services on ECS or K8s
  • Strong Linux networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN/hybrid)
  • Proven experience planning and executing migration to on-prem, colo, or private cloud (partial/hybrid OK — full exit not required)
  • Comfortable owning a multi-quarter infra initiative: TCO, design, vendors, cutover, rollback
  • Comfortable automating operational tasks with shell and/or Python
  • Fluent English (both spoken and written)

Strongly preferred

  • Colo/bare-metal ops: IPAM (NetBox), Ansible, image-based provisioning (Packer or equivalent), HAProxy/Nginx
  • Replacing managed AWS services with self-hosted (Postgres HA, Redis/Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch)
  • Email infrastructure (MTA, SMTP, IP reputation, DKIM/SPF/DMARC) — Halon or similar
  • Cloudflare (DNS/WAF/Access)
  • Observability beyond CloudWatch (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki or equivalent)
  • Prior work with multi-region SaaS or EU data residency
  • Cost-driven architecture / FinOps mindset

Would be a plus

  • GCP (BigQuery/certificates)
  • Comfortable reading Ruby or Go (used in our services and tooling)
  • AWS Certificates

Responsibilities day-to-day

  • Operate and evolve AWS multi-account / multi-region infra
  • Terraform modules/workspaces
  • Ensure safe infrastructure changes across network, storage, and services, with zero-downtime deployments.
  • ECS services, blue/green deploys, Docker image pipelines
  • Reliability: CloudWatch/PagerDuty/Sentry, capacity, cost tags
  • Security baseline: IAM, secrets (SSM), Cloudflare edge rules
  • Partner with engineers on release automation and production readiness
  • Maintain the hybrid estate (AWS and rented bare metal) as one operable platform

Migration leadership

  • Build the business and technical case for what moves off AWS vs what stays
  • Design the rented bare-metal / colo landing zone (compute, network, storage, observability, secrets)
  • Produce migration waves, dependency maps, cutover/rollback plans
  • Stand up hybrid connectivity and dual-run periods; shift traffic safely (e.g. via Cloudflare)
  • Replace or re-home managed services where it pays off (compute, queues, search, cache, MTA nodes)
  • Coordinate colo/vendors, timelines, and eng teams; report progress and risk

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.

At Childcare Marketing Group, we help childcare centers and early education businesses attract more families, strengthen their brands, and grow. Our creative work is not decoration — it is a critical part of how our clients communicate, compete, and generate results.

As our Senior Graphic Designer, you will take ownership of visual execution across a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work from concept through completion, translating marketing strategies and campaign objectives into creative that is compelling, commercially-minded, and built to perform.

This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a brief and follows instructions.

We want a designer who can think, challenge, create, refine, and raise the creative standard. Someone who understands that great design combines creativity with strategy, knows how to work at speed without sacrificing quality, and has the confidence to own projects from beginning to end.

You will work across multiple projects, brands, and formats while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently delivering work that clients are proud to put their name behind.

Compensation

  • Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and level of expertise.
  • Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential may be available based on performance and company programs.

Why You Should Work Here

● Work That Matters: You help transform lives by supporting the marketing of businesses that care for and educate children. Your creative work helps childcare providers connect with more families who need their services.

● Recession-Proof Growth: Childcare is an essential industry, and our clients need effective marketing to continue attracting families, filling places, and growing their businesses.

● Leadership That Has Your Back: You’ll work with a supportive, attentive, and motivated leadership team that wants you to succeed and gives you the support to keep developing.

● An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a high-performing company and team.

● Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are visible, your work matters, and you’re treated as a person rather than a headcount.

● Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection while staying closely connected to a collaborative international team.

● Top-of-Market Opportunity: We want exceptional people and believe strong talent should have the opportunity to grow with the company.

● Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

● A Workspace That Feels Alive: Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

● Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

● The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

● 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

● Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

● Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

● Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

● Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

● Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

● Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

● Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

● Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

● Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.

A Typical Week Might Include

● Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

● Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

● Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

● Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

● Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

● Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

● Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

● Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

● Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.

Key Competencies

● Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

● Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

● Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

● High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

● Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

● Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

● Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

● Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

● Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

● Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.

This Role Is Not for You If

● You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

● You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

● You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

● You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

● You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

● You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

● You need constant supervision to stay productive.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.description:
Senior Accountant – GAAP/IFRS, Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. client business hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to own critical accounting processes, maintain financial accuracy, support compliance, and provide reliable financial reporting and insights to leadership.

This is not a transactional bookkeeping role.

You’ll take ownership of core accounting functions including:

  • General ledger accounting
  • Month-end and quarter-end close
  • Balance sheet reconciliations
  • Financial reporting and variance analysis
  • Audit and tax support
  • Internal controls
  • Accounting process improvement
  • Junior team mentorship

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of GAAP/IFRS with hands-on accounting execution, analytical thinking, and a process-improvement mindset.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Account Reconciliations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for:
    • Accruals
    • Prepaid expenses
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Maintain reconciliations across approximately 15–30 key balance sheet accounts.
  • Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, deferred revenue, and other accounts.
  • Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved accurately.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready accounting records.

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

Own and coordinate monthly and quarterly close activities.

You will:

  • Prepare and review trial balances.
  • Ensure journal entries are complete and accurate.
  • Complete month-end close within approximately 5–7 business days, with a target of five days.
  • Maintain detailed close checklists.
  • Coordinate required cross-functional sign-offs.
  • Identify and resolve issues that could delay reporting.
  • Continuously improve close efficiency and accuracy.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance sheets
    • Cash flow statements
    • Supporting schedules
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis.
  • Investigate significant financial variances.
  • Prepare written commentary explaining financial performance.
  • Provide actionable financial insights for leadership.
  • Prepare supporting schedules for board meetings, audits, and other reporting requirements.

Audit, Tax & Compliance Support

  • Prepare PBC (Prepared by Client) schedules and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Respond to audit requests accurately and within required timelines.
  • Support timely and accurate filings for:
    • Sales tax
    • Property tax
    • Corporate income tax
  • Maintain accounting policies, controls, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure accounting processes align with applicable GAAP and/or IFRS standards.
  • Identify accounting or control risks and escalate issues appropriately.

Internal Controls & Accounting Accuracy

  • Maintain strong controls across accounting workflows.
  • Review reconciliations and supporting documentation for completeness.
  • Identify unusual transactions, exceptions, and accounting discrepancies.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and approval processes are followed.
  • Help maintain accurate, consistent, and audit-ready financial records.

Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to make accounting operations faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

You will:

  • Review existing accounting workflows and identify inefficiencies.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for accounting and reporting automation.
  • Update SOPs and accounting documentation.
  • Standardize recurring accounting processes.
  • Support ERP improvements and finance system optimization initiatives.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Review work completed by staff accountants and bookkeepers.
  • Provide feedback on reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.
  • Mentor junior team members on accounting treatments and best practices.
  • Help improve accuracy and consistency across the accounting function.
  • Support the professional development of junior accounting staff.

Cross-Functional Finance Collaboration

Partner with:

  • FP&A
  • Operations
  • Sales
  • Finance leadership
  • Other business stakeholders

You will:

  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes.
  • Collaborate on variance reviews.
  • Coordinate with operations and sales regarding revenue recognition.
  • Provide financial information needed for business decisions.
  • Translate accounting data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4–5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • General ledger accounting
    • Journal entries
    • Balance sheet reconciliations
    • Month-end close
    • Financial statement preparation
    • Variance analysis
    • Audit support
  • Experience with accounting systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • QuickBooks
    • Xero
    • SAP
    • Similar ERP/accounting platforms
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Conditional formatting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting certification.
  • NetSuite experience.
  • Multi-entity accounting and consolidations.
  • Foreign currency accounting.
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional services
    • Real estate
  • Experience supporting ERP implementations.
  • Accounting automation or finance transformation experience.
  • Experience working directly with FP&A teams.
  • Experience mentoring junior accountants or bookkeepers.
  • Familiarity with Confluence or similar documentation systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Understand accounting principles beyond basic bookkeeping.
  • Take ownership of financial accuracy and reporting deadlines.
  • Can independently manage month-end close responsibilities.
  • Are highly analytical without losing attention to detail.
  • Investigate discrepancies rather than simply recording adjustments.
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready documentation.
  • Can explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Look for ways to improve and automate repetitive accounting processes.
  • Are comfortable reviewing and mentoring junior team members.
  • Thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Morning

  • Review bank activity and reconcile recent transactions.
  • Post accruals for payroll, vendor invoices, and other expenses.
  • Review exception reports and investigate unusual activity.
  • Check progress against the accounting close calendar.

Midday

  • Prepare or review draft financial statements.
  • Analyze expense allocations against budgets and forecasts.
  • Investigate material variances.
  • Meet with Operations or other stakeholders regarding deferred revenue or reporting questions.

Afternoon

  • Review balance sheet reconciliations prepared by junior team members.
  • Provide feedback on accounting treatments and documentation.
  • Resolve outstanding close items.
  • Support audit, tax, or compliance requests.

End of Day

  • Update variance analysis and financial commentary.
  • Review month-end close progress.
  • Update accounting schedules, SOPs, and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare outstanding items for the following day.

In short: you ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, efficient, audit-ready, and useful for decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within 5 business days.
  • Less than 1% reconciliation error rate.
  • 100% of audit requests delivered on time.
  • Accurate and timely financial statements.
  • Strong quality and consistency of variance analysis.
  • Complete and audit-ready accounting documentation.
  • Improved close and reporting efficiency.
  • Effective mentorship and review of junior accounting staff.
  • Leadership confidence in financial reporting accuracy.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across core accounting operations.
  • Exposure to both accounting execution and financial analysis.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and FP&A.
  • Opportunity to improve accounting systems and processes.
  • Exposure to ERP and finance automation initiatives.
  • Fully remote environment with flexibility around U.S. client operations.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Accounting Manager
    • Senior Accounting Manager
    • Controller
    • Finance Operations Manager
    • Director of Accounting

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your overall accounting experience and the types of companies you’ve supported.
  • Your experience managing month-end and quarter-end close.
  • The number and types of balance sheet accounts you have personally reconciled.
  • Your experience working under GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Which accounting or ERP platforms you have used, particularly NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or SAP.
  • An example of a reconciliation discrepancy or accounting issue you identified and resolved.
  • Your experience preparing financial statements and variance analysis.
  • Your experience supporting external audits and preparing PBC schedules.
  • An accounting process you improved or automated.
  • Your experience reviewing or mentoring the work of junior accountants or bookkeepers.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand the depth of your accounting experience, technical knowledge, communication skills, and ability to take ownership of financial operations.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Accounting Task – Reconciliation & Variance Analysis
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong GAAP/IFRS accounting experience, can independently manage close and reconciliations, and take pride in producing accurate, decision-ready financial information, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.
