jobs.description:
Revenue Operations CRM Lead

Phunware | Full-time | Remote, U.S. based

Phunware, Inc. (NASDAQ: PHUN) is an enterprise software company specializing in mobile app solutions for hospitality, healthcare and other large property related customers, with integrated intelligent capabilities. We provide businesses with the tools to create, implement, and manage custom mobile applications, analytics, digital advertising, and location-based services. Phunware is transforming mobile engagement by delivering scalable, personalized, and data-driven mobile app experiences.

Phunware’s mission is to achieve unparalleled connectivity and monetization through the widespread adoption of Phunware mobile technologies, leveraging brands, consumers, partners, and market participants. Phunware is poised to expand its software products and services audience through new generative AI products and product enhancements which are in development, utilize and monetize its patents and other intellectual property, and focus on serving its enterprise customers and partners.

Why This Role Exists (and why it's scoped the way it is)

Most revenue operations job descriptions ask one person to be a systems administrator, a data analyst, an enablement leader, a project manager, and a strategist all at once. We think that is a reliable way to burn out a talented person and end up with mediocre results in every category. So we scoped this role on purpose.

This is a CRM-focused role. Your home base is HubSpot, and your mission is to help us repair and scale an instance that has only started getting real attention in the last year. Our goal is to make HubSpot the system of record for the business through a balance of making it genuinely simple to use while meeting real data requirements and governance thresholds.

You will not be doing this alone, and you will not be doing everything. You will report to and learn directly from a senior revenue operations practitioner, and you will have consultants in your corner for the heavier lifts. This is a place to go deep, build a specialty, and grow, not to spread yourself an inch thick across ten disciplines.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Own day-to-day administration and health of our HubSpot instance: users, permissions, fields, objects, workflows, lifecycle stages, and the general cleanup an older org tends to need.
  • Repair the accumulated cruft. Untangle what’s stale and no longer serves anyone, and rebuild so the instance scales.
  • Partner with sales and marketing to translate what they actually need into processes and workflows that hold up, rather than one-off requests that pile up as technical debt.
  • Move us toward HubSpot as the system of record by getting data in cleanly, structured correctly, and governed sensibly.
  • Integrate the tools our teams already love. If a preferred tool does the job, we would rather connect it than replace it (more on that below).
  • Document what you build so the next person, including future you, is not reverse-engineering a mystery.

How We Operate

If it ends up in HubSpot, we don't care where it came from or how it got there. Have preferred tools, will integrate. We are not precious about forcing every team into the CRM UI. The market is trending toward fewer salespeople and end users clicking around directly in HubSpot anyway, and we would rather meet people where they work and pipe clean data into the system of record.

Standard functionality first. Before we buy a tool or commission custom development, we exhaust what the platform already does out of the box. Custom work and new line items are sometimes the right answer, but they are the last answer, not the first.

End users are your customers. The best solution is usually the one that solves the real business need with the smallest amount of friction for the people using the system. We care more about that than about clever engineering nobody asked for.

What We're Looking For

  • A few years in B2B SaaS, ideally from a sales or marketing seat, so you have personally felt the pain of a clunky system and know what "make this easier" actually means to the people asking.
  • Some hands-on CRM experience, especially supporting a marketing or sales team by building out processes and workflows. You do not need a decade of it. You do need to have done it.
  • A default toward collaboration. You would rather pull the right stakeholders into a room and figure out the best solution together than disappear into a corner to tinker alone. You ask good clarifying questions and you actually enjoy the conversation.
  • Comfort saying "not yet" or "here is a better way" tactfully. You get to the root of what someone is trying to solve before you say yes to the literal request.

The Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect assesses application portfolios, defines migration strategies for individual workloads using the 7 Rs of cloud migration, and designs secure, scalable architectures within AWS GovCloud. The role is responsible for planning and executing application and data migrations, automating infrastructure deployment, coordinating migration waves, minimizing downtime, and managing technical and business risk throughout the migration lifecycle.

This position ensures migrated environments meet applicable security, compliance, performance, resiliency, and operational requirements. The engineer/architect will also support modernization initiatives, enterprise migration governance, Zero Trust architecture, secure connectivity between on-premises environments and AWS GovCloud, and standardized cloud landing-zone patterns.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assess enterprise application portfolios and determine the appropriate migration approach for each workload using the 7 Rs: rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire, retain, and relocate.
  • Design secure, scalable, highly available AWS GovCloud architectures that meet application, mission, security, and operational requirements.
  • Develop migration plans, dependency mappings, migration runbooks, cutover procedures, rollback strategies, and validation criteria.
  • Use AWS migration services including AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), AWS DataSync, AWS Application Discovery Service, and AWS Migration Hub.
  • Migrate applications, virtual machines, databases, file systems, and enterprise data to AWS GovCloud while minimizing downtime and operational disruption.
  • Design and deploy compute and container platforms using Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECS as appropriate to workload requirements.
  • Plan and execute storage, database, and data migrations, including data synchronization, replication, validation, and cutover activities.
  • Design hybrid and cloud networking architectures using AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Direct Connect, VPN connectivity, routing, DNS, and security controls.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform and other approved infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Implement standardized AWS GovCloud environments using the Landing Zone Accelerator on AWS (LZA) and approved enterprise landing-zone patterns.
  • Use FIPS endpoints and approved cryptographic configurations where required by security and compliance requirements.
  • Design secure approaches for on-premises-to-GovCloud data transfer, accounting for the absence of a native cross-partition transfer path where applicable.
  • Implement micro-segmentation and security-group architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles and workload-specific access requirements.
  • Coordinate migration waves across application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, database, and business teams.
  • Identify and manage migration dependencies, technical risks, business risks, outage windows, resource constraints, and remediation activities.
  • Validate migrated workloads for functionality, performance, security, resilience, observability, and operational readiness before production acceptance.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, recovery, and operational support capabilities for migrated environments.
  • Identify and execute application modernization opportunities, including containerization, managed services, automation, and cloud-native architectural improvements where appropriate.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing AWS cloud architectures, preferably within AWS GovCloud.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application migration strategies and the 7 Rs migration framework.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS migration tooling such as MGN, DMS, DataSync, Application Discovery Service, and Migration Hub.
  • Experience migrating enterprise applications, servers, databases, storage platforms, and data to AWS.
  • Strong experience with EC2, EKS, ECS, storage services, database services, and cloud-native application architectures.
  • Experience designing hybrid cloud networking with Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPNs, routing, DNS, and network-security controls.
  • Hands-on experience developing infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Experience with Landing Zone Accelerator on AWS, AWS Organizations, account structures, guardrails, and standardized cloud foundations.
  • Understanding of FIPS endpoints, encryption requirements, and secure data-transfer patterns within government cloud environments.
  • Experience designing micro-segmented network architectures and security-group policies aligned with Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong understanding of application dependency analysis, migration-wave planning, cutover management, rollback planning, and technical risk management.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, operational readiness, backup, disaster recovery, and post-migration optimization.
  • Familiarity with application modernization, containerization, managed services, and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, regulated, or other compliance-driven environments is preferred.
  • Strong architecture, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, stakeholder coordination, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

    • Preferred Certifications:

    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
    • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
    • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
    • AWS Certified Security – Specialty

jobs.description:
Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer
Location: Remote, Option for Hybrid in Bay Area

For generations, midlife women's health has been neglected. While roughly 2 million American women enter perimenopause or menopause every year, up to 75% of those who seek medical care walk away untreated—often because less than 20% of OB-GYN residency programs offer formal menopause training.

Most women come to Midi seeking relief from symptoms like hot flashes and poor sleep. But what they receive is comprehensive, whole-woman care. At Midi, we know that achieving the best health outcomes requires looking at the complete picture. Beyond symptom management, our clinical model proactively targets the critical health shifts happening under the surface—including cardiovascular health and cholesterol, bone density, thyroid function, and metabolic risks like pre-diabetes.

As the leading virtual care clinic dedicated to midlife health, Midi is scaling rapidly to meet this overdue demand. We are now onboarding 1,000 new patients every day and conducting 25,000 virtual visits per week. To ensure this high-standard care is accessible to all, Midi operates as a fully integrated partner across the broader healthcare ecosystem—collaborating closely with major health plans, employers, and leading health systems to make comprehensive midlife care a connected, covered, and standard part of healthcare.

The Role:

Midi is looking for a VP of Commercial Marketing to own the strategy, execution, and results that establish Midi as a B2B powerhouse. This is not a support function — you are the executive accountable for the commercial marketing P&L, for the pipeline our enterprise partnerships depend on, and for the credibility of the Midi brand across the entire B2B landscape.

You will build and lead a multidisciplinary marketing organization, evolve Midi's brand beyond DTC, and architect high-impact programs that expand strategic partnerships and drive member acquisition pull-through at scale. You will be judged on outcomes: pipeline generated, partnerships closed, LTV/CAC improved, and revenue influenced. You bring the strategic vision of a marketing executive and the operating discipline of someone who has personally driven a number before.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer and sitting on the extended leadership team, this role demands command of the full commercial marketing function — team leadership, budget ownership, cross-functional influence at the C-suite and board level, and a deep, working understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including payers, employers, health systems, and the patients we serve together.

What You'll Own:

Critical Functions:

B2B Messaging & Positioning — Partner with Midi Commercial leadership to refine positioning across payers, employers, and health system partners, crafting the narrative that creates urgency and closes the gap between interest and commitment.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM) — Architect and run high-touch, data-informed ABM strategies that penetrate high-value enterprise accounts, including large payers and Fortune 500 employers, with clear ownership of account-level outcomes.

Modern MarTech & AI-Enabled Infrastructure — Build and scale a sophisticated MarTech stack with robust attribution and end-to-end data visibility. Bring an innovation mindset to how AI and automation reshape marketing operations, content velocity, and campaign performance — you should be someone who's already using AI tools daily and pushing your team to do the same, not waiting for a mandate to do so.

Data-Driven Thought Leadership — Partner with Midi's clinical and research teams to build and run an authoritative thought-leadership engine that strengthens brand trust and fuels demand generation — and hold it accountable to pipeline impact.

Market & Competitive Intelligence — Build and maintain command of the competitive and market landscape, translating research into positioning and product marketing decisions the business acts on.

Commercial Marketing Strategy & P&L — Set and own the B2B marketing strategy, budget, and KPIs. You are accountable for the results this function delivers against Midi's enterprise growth goals, not just for producing the plan.

Pipeline & Revenue Outcomes — Drive measurable pipeline contribution and revenue influence across payer, employer, and health system channels. Own LTV/CAC as a metric you actively manage, test against, and improve — not one you simply report on.

Member Acquisition & Growth — Drive scalable, segment-specific member acquisition through continuous testing, message refinement, and multi-channel optimization, owning the growth number end to end.

Commercial Partnership — Act as the marketing counterpart to the Commercial leadership team, delivering the collateral, training, RFP support, and deal-stage content that shortens sales cycles — and take shared ownership of the commercial outcomes that result.

Leadership & Executive Alignment — Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing marketing organization. Drive alignment across executive leadership, and represent commercial marketing as a full voice at the leadership table.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role building, scaling, and running high-performing marketing teams and budgets in high-growth environments; healthcare, digital health, or a highly regulated B2B/B2B2C environment strongly preferred.
  • A demonstrated track record of owning a number — pipeline, revenue influence, LTV/CAC, or similar — and being able to speak concretely to how you moved it.
  • Deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, with direct experience marketing to and negotiating credibility with payers, employers, and health systems.
  • Fluency with modern marketing automation and MarTech stacks (HubSpot a plus), and genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools to increase team leverage, speed, and creative output — you see AI as a lever for competitive advantage, not a compliance checkbox.
  • Experience owning and managing a significant marketing budget.
  • Proven success architecting and executing data-driven ABM strategies that penetrate large enterprise accounts and accelerate sales pipelines.
  • Executive presence: comfortable operating and influencing at the CMO/C-suite and board level, translating strategy into a story that lands with non-marketers.
  • A bias toward action — someone who moves from strategy to execution without needing to be pushed, and who treats ambiguity as something to resolve rather than escalate.
  • Strong people leadership: a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining strong marketers, and of building a team culture that expects ownership rather than assigns tasks.

The Substrate PAVC Engineer supports patching, antivirus, and vulnerability compliance across Microsoft Substrate environments. This role focuses on Windows servicing, PowerShell automation, Kusto Query Language analysis, and troubleshooting patch deployment failures across a large server fleet.

You’ll help deliver Windows security patches, Defender platform and signature updates, .NET updates, and vulnerability remediation activities safely and consistently. jobs.description:
Support Engineer

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Support Engineer to protect Engineering's capacity, give the Support team greater leverage, and make sure the problems that matter most get seen and fixed fast.

You'll report into Engineering but embed daily with the Support team. They handle most customer issues directly, but the particularly tough cases they can't crack land on your desk, and you'll work with them to diagnose the problem and resolve it. When it's a real bug, you'll hand Product and Engineering a clean, well-scoped ticket with everything they need to fix it quickly.

But the lasting impact of this role isn't in solving individual tickets. It's in building the systems that help the whole Support team get better: the things that help them answer their own questions before they need to ask you, and help you answer yours before you need to ask a PM or software engineer.

If you do great work here and want to grow into a software engineering role, we'll be excited to support that career growth. This seat is on the Engineering team for a reason.

What You'll Do

Own the escalation path above the Support team's top tier. Diagnose and resolve the issues that have them stumped by scouring logs and dashboards, running database queries, and drawing on your growing knowledge of our systems.

Build the systems that give the Support team leverage: runbooks, diagnostic scripts, automations, internal dashboards, tighter escalation workflows, and AI-assisted triage tooling.

Coach the Support team on technical troubleshooting and what makes a strong escalation: the right context, the right logs, clear reproduction steps. This feedback loop is one of the most valuable things you'll create. Over time, the whole team gets sharper, and the escalations that reach you arrive better every round.

When real bugs surface, file well-scoped tickets with reproduction steps, relevant logs, and enough context that Engineering can solve the problem quickly and Product knows where to slot it in priority.

Keep Engineering focused on building. You're the filter that turns a flood of "something's broken" into a short list of real, well-documented problems they can act on quickly.

Use AI tools to diagnose issues faster, write and maintain runbooks, and build internal tooling.

What We're Looking For

A relentless troubleshooter. You don't stop at "I can't reproduce it." You dig through logs, trace the data, check the timeline, and figure out what actually happened. And you deeply understand the business context, so you know where to focus your efforts first.

A systems builder. You see the same class of issue come through three times and your instinct is to build something so nobody has to escalate it again: a runbook, a script, a dashboard.

A clear, direct communicator. You translate messy customer-reported symptoms into precise technical descriptions. You write bug reports that engineers love to read. You explain technical problems to non-technical people without talking down or hand-waving.

An AI power user. You use AI to move faster: diagnosing problems, uncovering tricky system behavior, building internal tools. You don't wait for someone to hand you a playbook.

Technically strong at the tooling layer. You're at home in monitoring and observability platforms like Grafana, Honeycomb, and CloudWatch, comfortable writing database queries, and you know your way around GitHub and Jira. You can read logs, trace request flows, and understand what the system is telling you.

Someone who makes both teams better. Support improves because you coach them on technical troubleshooting and what makes a strong escalation. Engineering improves because the only tickets that reach them are real, well-documented, and ready to act on.

Experience required:

  • 3+ years in a technical support, support engineering, SRE, or similar troubleshooting-heavy role, or equivalent experience that shows strong diagnostic and systems-building skills
  • Comfortable working with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and database queries
  • Experience with issue tracking and engineering workflow tools (e.g., Jira, GitHub)
  • Strong written communication. You document clearly and write bug reports that engineers can act on right away.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in your own work
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States or Canada

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Ability to read and trace through a web application codebase (PHP/React or similar) to diagnose issues at the code level
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or automations that made a support team more effective
  • Familiarity with HIPAA-compliant environments
  • A track record of shaping the escalation process between Support and Engineering, making both sides better in the process

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
    Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
    Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: Tell us about a tough technical problem you dug into: how you found it, what tools you used, and how it got resolved. What's something you built or improved that made a support or operations team more effective? And why is this position the one you've been hoping to find?

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Video: 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate.

We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you can ship work you're proud of.

Candidates only. No recruiters, please.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. From next-generation fighters to autonomous unmanned systems, we're building the future of aerial warfare. When pilots take off on missions, when commanders make split-second decisions, when national security hangs in the balance—our technology is there. We're not just building aircraft; we're building the edge that keeps our nation safe and our warfighters protected.

The teams behind Advanced Effects and the Barracuda & Roadrunner families. ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Recruiting Manager, you are the single-threaded owner of talent delivery for a Business Line and/or Strategic Program within one of Anduril's Divisions. You combine strategic business partnership with direct people leadership. This role exists at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are embedded deeply within your Business Line - understanding its programs, products, revenue drivers, and leadership priorities at a level that allows you to translate business objectives into hiring strategies, prioritize demand against capacity, and ensure the right talent lands on the right programs at the right time.

As a Sr. Recruiting Manger, you add direct people leadership - owning performance management, coaching, career development, and capacity allocation for a team of recruiters while simultaneously acting as the strategic advisor for your key stakeholders.

You are the voice of the business to TA and the voice of TA to the business. You own the hiring plan, the reporting, the escalations, and the outcomes. This is the formalized leadership layer within our Business Line construct - the person who ensures every major program and initiative has the talent it needs to hit its milestones.

Strategic Business Partnership & Ownership

  • Own all hiring progress reporting for your Business Line, delivering regular updates to divisional leadership and acting as the primary escalation point for hiring blockers.

Recruiting Execution & Delivery

  • Set the standard for recruiting excellence: sourcing strategy, candidate engagement, assessment rigor, and closing. You are the bar that your team calibrates against.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Provide direct people leadership for recruiters aligned to your Business Line: performance management, coaching, mentorship, career development, and structured feedback through regular 1:1s.
  • Manage recruiter allocation, capacity, and performance tracking — acting as the single source of truth for the Divisional Head of TA on team health and delivery confidence.
  • Foster a high-performance culture that emphasizes skill development, collaboration, data discipline, and delivering a world-class candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Provide structured, high-quality feedback into recruiter performance reviews, ensuring business impact and hiring outcomes are recognized alongside activity metrics.

Functional Excellence & Process Rigor

  • Drive consistency in role intakes, interview processes, compensation calibration, and candidate experience across your BL — ensuring every search runs to a standard, not ad hoc.
  • Champion cross-BL collaboration and candidate sharing within your Division — optimizing talent placement and ensuring fungible, high-quality pipelines across programs.

  • Partner with Recruiting Operations on tooling, reporting, and automation opportunities specific to your BL's hiring patterns.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive TA experience, with significant experience owning a business unit's hiring strategy. Fully autonomous. Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence VP-level stakeholders.

  • Experience leading hiring initiatives beyond individual searches: surge campaigns, batch hiring, portfolio prioritization, capacity planning.
  • Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, managing competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal oversight.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience managing or leading a team of recruiters
  • Experience partnering with BizOps, Finance, and HR Business Partners on workforce planning, budget alignment, and headcount governance.

  • Experience building and scaling recruiting operations for a specific business unit during a period of high growth or organizational change.

You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members as a clinical professional on our Medical Management/Health Services team. Centene is a diversified, national organization offering competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

Pharmacist (Specialty) - Remote - Candidates must reside in and hold an active pharmacist license in FL, TX, MO, CA, or MI.

Job Specific Details:

  • Ensure patients receive the right medication, know how to use their medication, and address/resolve drug therapy issues prior to dispensing.

  • Review and enter prescription orders accurately and efficiently.

  • Provide patient counseling and education regarding medications and treatment plans.

  • Verify prescription data entry for completeness and accuracy.

  • Conduct drug utilization reviews to identify and resolve potential therapy-related concerns.

  • Partner with clinics to clarify and obtain prescriptions

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

  • A collaborative, adaptable professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • A patient-focused commitment to delivering high-quality specialty care.

Work Schedule: 11AM - 7:30PM if you are (Eastern), 10AM - 6:30PM if you are (Central) or 8AM - 4:30PM if you are (Pacific), Monday through Friday. Some holidays are required when business is open.

Position Purpose:
Coordinate and assist in managing and participating in pharmacy services, including dispensing of medications, quality assurance and clinical monitoring activities.

  • Participate in decisions regarding the pharmaceutical services within assigned scope including:

  • Assessing the patient's general pharmaceutical needs

  • Planning for the pharmaceutical services provision

  • Participating in the overall plan of care

  • Participating in the overall quality assessment and improvement plan

  • Receive physician prescription orders and evaluate the appropriateness of these orders for dosage, drug choice, potential drug interactions, route of administration and stability

  • Supervise the filling, receiving, compounding, and dispensing activities involved in providing finished product to the patient

  • Ensure that the patient chart is complete for allergies, height, weight, current and past medical history, clinical laboratory results and concurrent medications (including over the counter or home remedy medications)

  • Ensure that when necessary, laboratory tests have been ordered and the results are obtained and discussed with the nurse and the physician

  • Provide patient counseling, education, and monitoring

  • Ensure safety of patients and personnel by exercising good pharmacy practice in the process of drug therapy instructions to the patient

  • Determine remaining doses on hand to manage inventory and avoid waste

  • Provide clinical interventions

  • Assess responses to therapy, patient compliance, and ongoing review of drug regimens; report and manage adverse events

  • Assist the physician, nurse and patient with clinical and technical support

  • Document all communication with physicians, nurses and patients in the patient chart

  • Assist in the maintenance and upkeep of all necessary paperwork required by state and federal agencies as well as the Joint Commission

  • Assist the Pharmacy Manager in implementing new procedures

  • Assist in the training and supervision of Pharmacy Technicians, Pharmacy Interns and other pharmacy personnel

  • Participate in Performance Improvement Projects

  • Assist in providing in-service programs to nursing and pharmacy personnel on any aspect of drug therapy

  • Attend and/or complete education and training programs

  • Review literature and other materials pertinent to the practice of pharmacy

  • Complete all competency/skills assessment requirements

  • Participate in on-call schedule

  • Perform other tasks as determined by the Pharmacist-In-Charge

  • Comply with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy and 3+ years of mail order, retail or hospital pharmacy experience OR Pharm D.

Licenses/Certifications: Current state’s Pharmacist license and license at other states as required. Must reside in and hold an active pharmacist license in FL, TX, MO, CA, or MI.

Pay Range: $51.78 - $95.81 per hour

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

Description

TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal?

We are continuously looking for experienced UX/UI Design professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply?

Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video where you answer a few questions, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

  • Host regular live Q&A sessions to help students unblock and progress confidently
  • Offer personalized support through 1:1 video calls to answer questions and guide assignments
  • Occasionally respond to student questions via direct messages
  • Lead live lessons on core program topics and industry-relevant skills
  • Share your professional insights and best practices to support the learning community
  • Review student projects and provide feedback based on program standards
  • Write clear, actionable feedback to help students improve and meet expectations
  • Support students in text by explaining concepts, troubleshooting code, and clarifying project or review questions

Requirements

We require over 3 years of hands-on experience in UX/UI Design, with expertise in:

  • Design Thinking and Visual Design: Proven proficiency in applying user-centered design principles, creating visually appealing and functional designs, and adjusting them based on user needs and feedback.
  • UX Research and Usability Testing: Skilled in conducting and analyzing user interviews, usability tests, and contextual inquiries to gather insights that inform design decisions.
  • Prototyping and Interaction Design: Proficient with tools like Figma, Sketch, or InVision for wireframing, interactive prototyping, and design iteration.
  • UI Design Systems and Accessibility: Knowledgeable in building scalable design systems and adhering to accessibility guidelines to ensure usability for diverse users.
  • Ability to explain complex topics in understandable terms.
  • Patience and empathy toward students.

Nice to have:

  • Teaching or tutoring experience.
  • Have your own experience as a student online, and the desire to help create the best place in the world to study UX/UI Design!

What we can offer you

  • Flexible & remote collaboration.
  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • A schedule that’s convenient for you. There isn’t a focus on micromanaging.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — to make working together seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across the US and LatAm, and loves what it does!
  • Growth — our product is growing rapidly, so it’s an excellent time to join us and challenge yourself professionally.
  • Meaningful impact — share your knowledge and support others as they launch new careers in tech.

We're excited to get to know you and collaborate! ?

jobs.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.

This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role spanning the experience layer (React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL), API and orchestration (Apigee, Auth0, Redis, Kafka), the AI-powered Leadership Intelligence layer (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Neo4j, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow), systems of record (Salesforce, PostgreSQL), and DevOps/hosting (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog): taking features from concept through production release, instrumenting them, and iterating on data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full feature lifecycle architecture, implementation, code review, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Build responsive React/TypeScript frontends integrated with Optimizely; design Apollo GraphQL schemas and resolvers served through Apigee; build modular Node.js/NestJS backend services using Redis for caching and Kafka for event-driven workflows.

  • Design and query PostgreSQL schemas (TypeORM/Prisma); collaborate on Snowflake pipelines and dbt models feeding the Leadership Intelligence layer.

  • Integrate OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs for AI-powered discovery, recommendations, and matching; work with Neo4j graph data for relationship-driven insights.

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows (pair programming, code generation, test scaffolding) to increase velocity without compromising quality; handle AI feature failures, timeouts, and token costs with a production mindset.

  • Instrument features with PostHog and Datadog; design and run A/B experiments and feature-flag rollouts via Optimizely; use data to drive iteration.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions, ADRs, and post-incident reviews; address performance bottlenecks across the stack (GraphQL resolvers, N+1 queries, frontend rendering, mobile time-to-interactive).

  • Partner with product, design, the Lead Security Engineer, and DevOps to ensure features are secure, well-architected, and operationally sound from the start.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjusts communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience shipping production-grade products end-to-end.

  • Strong TypeScript/React skills (component architecture, state management, hooks, performance).

  • Backend experience with Node.js and NestJS building modular, tested services.

  • GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, subscriptions, Apollo client/server) and familiarity with API gateway patterns (Apigee or equivalent).

  • PostgreSQL proficiency (query optimization, schema design, TypeORM/Prisma).

  • Experience with Auth0 or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Familiarity with Redis and Kafka (or similar) for caching and event-driven/message-queue patterns.

PREFERED

  • Production experience with OpenAI, Google Gemini, or other LLM APIs (prompt engineering, rate limiting, fallback handling, cost management).

  • Strong architectural thinking and clear technical communication; experience with high-autonomy, end-to-end ownership.

  • Neo4j or other graph database experience.

  • Snowflake/data warehouse experience with dbt or Airflow.

  • Optimizely or similar experimentation/feature-management platforms.

  • Salesforce integration experience.

  • AWS experience (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch).

  • Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

  • Testing with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright (unit, integration, e2e).

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

EOE

YPO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. YPO takes pride in supporting a diverse workforce and demonstrates this through its policies and practices. YPO does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Enterprise Applications Manager

Location: Remote, United States

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Enterprise Applications Manager to join our CRM & Revenue Technology team within Revenue Operations. This newly created role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations and Product Management, serving as the technical bridge between our Salesforce CRM ecosystem and internally developed enterprise applications.

As the Enterprise Applications Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of complex integration projects spanning Salesforce, Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, and Onboarding systems. This role requires a unique blend of technical depth (integration architecture, API design, Workato development), operational excellence (RevOps processes, data governance), and product thinking (requirements gathering, stakeholder management, feature prioritization).

You will be the primary business point of contact for all enterprise application projects, partnering with Engineering, Product, GTM leadership, and Revenue Operations to design scalable integration solutions that enable revenue growth. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring strong technical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a self-starter mentality. You'll be working in a dynamic environment where you'll need to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive projects from requirements gathering through deployment and ongoing optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Implementation

  • Own the design and deployment of integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications (Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, Onboarding) using Workato or similar iPaaS platforms
  • Design integration patterns that ensure data consistency, real-time synchronization, and proper error handling across systems; establish integration best practices and reusable patterns for the team
  • Define Requirements for API connections between Salesforce and internal applications; understand REST/SOAP APIs, authentication methods (OAuth, API keys), and webhook architectures
  • Gather requirements for complex Workato recipes including conditional logic, data transformations, lookup tables, error handling, and batch processing; optimize recipes for performance and reliability
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for all integrations; proactively identify and resolve integration failures, performance issues, and data quality problems

Project Management & Product Ownership

  • Act as technical product owner for enterprise application initiatives; gather requirements from GTM stakeholders, translate business needs into technical specifications, and prioritize feature requests
  • Create detailed technical documentation including integration architecture diagrams, data flow maps, API specifications, and user guides for enterprise applications
  • Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination; develop test plans, manage UAT execution with business users, track defects, and ensure successful production deployment
  • Build product roadmaps for enterprise applications in collaboration with stakeholders; balance technical debt, new feature requests, and operational maintenance needs

Salesforce Administration & Configuration

  • Create Salesforce product roadmap to support enterprise application integrations, including custom objects, fields, validation rules, process builders, flows, and permission sets
  • Manage complex Salesforce data models spanning multiple custom objects and relationships; ensure data integrity and optimize for reporting and integration performance
  • Create and maintain Salesforce reports, dashboards, and list views to provide visibility into enterprise application data and integration health for stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators to ensure alignment on data governance, security model, and platform best practices across all enterprise integrations

Data Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish and enforce data governance standards for enterprise applications including data dictionaries, field definitions, validation rules, and master data management policies
  • Own data quality for all enterprise application integrations; implement automated data validation, cleansing routines, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy

Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills

  • 4-6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Salesforce administration, or technical product management roles with heavy integration/systems focus
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems using iPaaS platforms (Workato strongly preferred; Zapier, MuleSoft, or similar also acceptable)
  • Deep Salesforce knowledge including data model, security model, automation tools (Flow, Process Builder), custom objects, and API capabilities; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred
  • Strong understanding of API concepts including REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, authentication methods (OAuth 2.0, API keys), rate limiting, and error handling
  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis and troubleshooting; experience querying databases and understanding relational data models
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis, transformation, and mapping exercises (XLOOKUP, pivot tables, complex formulas)
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services environments with complex revenue operations and compliance requirements
  • Understanding of revenue operations workflows including lead-to-opportunity, customer onboarding, and renewal processes

Key Competencies

  • Systems thinker with ability to understand complex technical architectures and how systems interact across the enterprise technology stack
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Operations, and GTM teams to deliver shared outcomes
  • Self-starter with strong ownership mentality; able to take ambiguous requirements and deliver complete solutions with minimal supervision
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills; able to diagnose integration failures, data issues, and performance problems methodically
  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence decision-making at all levels
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality, security best practices, and technical documentation
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity; able to thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and requirements evolve
  • Product mindset with focus on user experience, scalability, and long-term maintainability of technical solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workato certification or extensive hands-on experience building production-grade integrations in Workato
  • Salesforce Admin Certification
  • Experience with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran) and understanding of ELT/ETL patterns
  • Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices for integration deployments
  • Experience with credit underwriting platforms, entity management systems, or financial services applications
  • Exposure to Agile product management tools (Jira, Asana, Linear) and product development lifecycle
  • Basic scripting skills (Python, JavaScript) for data transformation and automation tasks
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, Insomnia) and debugging integration issues
  • Previous experience in a technical product management or business systems analyst role

This is an exciting opportunity to build and scale the enterprise application ecosystem for a growing Revenue Operations team. If you're passionate about building elegant technical solutions, thrive at the intersection of RevOps and Product, and want to make a measurable impact on revenue-critical systems, we'd love to hear from you.

About Convera

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories.
Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.
As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.
There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments.
Apply now!

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in der Weiterentwicklung der Marketing- und Growth-Engine von unserem Kooperationspartner und arbeitest eng mit den Foundern zusammen.

  • Wachstumspotenzial: Wir wollen jemanden, der es gewohnt ist, operativ anzupacken, Projekte zu strukturieren und Menschen zu leiten - mit der Perspektive auf Head of Growth
  • Paid Social skalieren: Du steuerst und optimierst Meta- und LinkedIn-Kampagnen eigenständig – von Setup und Testing bis zur Skalierung.
  • Full-Funnel-Denken: Du schaust auf den gesamten Weg bis zum qualifizierten Sales Lead und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.
  • Performance verstehen: CAC, CPA, ROAS und Conversion Rates sind für dich Grundlage deiner Entscheidungen.
  • Tracking & Reporting aufsetzen: Du arbeitest hands-on mit GA4, GTM, UTM-Parametern und HubSpot und stellst sicher, dass Performance sauber messbar ist.
  • Funnel optimieren: Du identifizierst Bottlenecks, entwickelst Tests und verbesserst Landingpages, Lead-Nurturing und Conversion-Prozesse.
  • AI nutzen: Du entwickelst mit HubSpot, Make, Zapier und AI-Tools effizientere Marketing- und Nurturing-Prozesse.
  • Google Ads mitdenken: Du kannst Kampagnen und Ergebnisse fundiert bewerten, Freelancer steuern und den Kanal perspektivisch stärker intern übernehmen.
  • Neue Wachstums-Chancen erkennen: TikTok, Native Ads, Creator-Kampagnen oder Affiliate-Modelle können künftig dazukommen. Du bewertest, was skalierbar ist und was nicht.
  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust Prozesse so auf, dass Wachstum nicht vom Zufall abhängt – von Kampagnenstrukturen über Reporting bis zu wiederholbaren Tests.
  • Tools: GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM-Strukturen, Make, Zapier, HubSpot & immer offen für Neues

Wichtig: Hier geht es nicht um Branding, Design oder Community Management. Der Kern deiner Rolle ist Performance, Growth, Conversion und Skalierung.

Qualifikation

  • 3–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
  • Start-up, Scale-up oder Agency-Erfahrung: Du bist es gewohnt, dass Prioritäten sich schnell verändern und Eigeninitiative entscheidend ist.
  • Meta Ads und LinkedIn Ads hands-on: Kampagnen selbstständig aufsetzen, analysieren und skalieren.
  • Performanceorientierte Steuerung von skalierenden Werbebudgets.
  • Full-Funnel-Strategien entwickeln und umsetzen.
  • Sicher mit Tracking, Reporting und Performance-Daten.
  • Erfahrung mit GA4, GTM und HubSpot.
  • Google Ads verstehen – du musst hier kein absoluter Spezialist sein.
  • Erfahrung mit Automation und AI-Tools wie Make, Zapier, Claude oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • strukturiertes und organisiertes Arbeiten, ohne an Geschwindigkeit zu verlieren.
  • Erfahrung mit Projekt- oder Teamverantwortung.
  • sehr gutes Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1).

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit SEO/SEA, Landingpage-Optimierung bzw. Webflow, TikTok Ads, Native Advertising, Creator-/Influencer-Kampagnen oder Affiliate-Modellen.

Benefits

Warum ist diese Rolle spannend für dich

  • Echte Ownership - Du bekommst nicht nur Briefings, sondern gestaltest Strategie, Tests und Prioritäten selbst mit.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf Wachstum - Marketing soll zu einem der zentralen Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens werden – und du bekommst die Möglichkeit, diesen Bereich entscheidend mit aufzubauen.
  • Direkter Draht zu den Foundern - Kurze Entscheidungswege, schnelle Tests und wenig Konzernpolitik.
  • Perspektive Head of Growth - Wenn du zeigst, dass du Growth erfolgreich aufbauen und skalieren kannst, soll deine Verantwortung mit dem Unternehmen wachsen, perspektivisch auch mit Teamverantwortung.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum - Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Strukturen, Prozesse und neue Kanäle selbst mit aufzubauen.

Unser Kooperationspartner digitalisiert einen Prozess, der traditionell von Papier, Bürokratie und langen Wartezeiten geprägt ist, und hat dafür eine digitale Lösung entwickelt.

Die nächste Herausforderung lautet deshalb nicht mehr nur:
„Wie bekommen wir mehr Traffic?“

Sondern:

„Wie bauen wir eine Growth Engine, die messbar, wiederholbar und skalierbar neue Kunden gewinnt?“
Genau dabei sollst du eine zentrale Rolle übernehmen.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Level? Dann bewirb dich jetzt online.

jobs.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Identity Management Engineer / Architect designs, implements, and operates a secure, scalable enterprise identity platform spanning on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning, strong authentication, least-privilege access, modern application federation, privileged account management, and continuous identity governance, monitoring, and auditing.

This position is foundational to the Zero Trust identity pillar and ensures that users, administrators, applications, and workloads receive appropriate access based on verified identity, policy, risk, and mission requirements. The engineer/architect will support government and regulated environments through PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, phishing-resistant MFA, FICAM-aligned identity practices, privileged-access controls, and secure integration across enterprise identity platforms.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate enterprise IAM / ICAM architectures supporting on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Engineer and maintain directory services, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID where included in the approved architecture.
  • Design and automate user provisioning, deprovisioning, role assignment, access changes, and identity lifecycle management processes.
  • Integrate enterprise applications using modern identity and federation standards including SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) controls for administrative, elevated, and high-risk accounts.
  • Design and operate Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities using SailPoint or approved enterprise identity-governance platforms.
  • Integrate and administer AWS IAM Identity Center and related AWS identity and access-management capabilities.
  • Implement PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, certificate-based authentication, and other approved strong-authentication mechanisms.
  • Enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged and mission-critical access.
  • Align identity architectures, authentication methods, credential lifecycle processes, and access controls with FICAMrequirements and applicable government identity standards.
  • Develop and enforce least-privilege, role-based, and policy-based access controls across enterprise systems and applications.
  • Automate identity-management processes using scripting, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, and workflow technologies.
  • Integrate PAM, IGA, directory, cloud identity, and authentication platforms to provide consistent identity controls across environments.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, auditing, and alerting for authentication events, privileged activity, identity lifecycle changes, and access-policy violations.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, entitlement analysis, privileged-account reviews, and identity-governance activities.
  • Partner with application, cloud, cybersecurity, platform, and DevSecOps teams to securely onboard applications and services into enterprise identity platforms.
  • Troubleshoot complex authentication, federation, provisioning, directory synchronization, authorization, and access-management issues.
  • Maintain identity architecture documentation, integration standards, operational procedures, access-control models, and governance processes.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, engineering, or administering enterprise IAM / ICAM solutions.
  • Strong experience with Active Directory and cloud-based directory services such as Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Hands-on experience with identity federation and provisioning standards including SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Experience implementing or operating Privileged Access Management platforms and privileged identity workflows.
  • Experience with Identity Governance and Administration, preferably using SailPoint IdentityIQ or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
  • Experience with AWS IAM, AWS IAM Identity Center, and cloud identity integration.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, RBAC, ABAC, least privilege, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience implementing PIV/CAC, certificate-based authentication, and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Familiarity with FICAM, federal identity standards, and authentication requirements for government environments.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture, with particular emphasis on identity as a primary policy-enforcement and access-control pillar.
  • Experience automating identity workflows using APIs, scripting languages, PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or comparable automation technologies.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with SaaS applications, cloud services, enterprise applications, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience with centralized logging, identity monitoring, audit reporting, access reviews, and compliance evidence collection.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, GovCloud, or other regulated environments is preferred.
  • Strong architecture, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

    • Preferred Certifications:

    • AWS Certified Security – Specialty
    • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
    • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
    • SailPoint IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud certification
    • CyberArk Defender or CyberArk Sentry
We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITYXsolla is seeking a Head of Investor Relations for the Xsolla Credit Fund, whose primary mandate is LP capital raising.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Xsolla is seeking a Head of Investor Relations for the Xsolla Credit Fund, whose primary mandate is LP capital raising. While Xsolla's Capital Markets team covers investor relations across all of the company's strategic vehicles, this role is dedicated to the credit fund. Over time the role will also support fundraising for other Xsolla investment products, but the credit fund remains the primary focus.This is a relationship-led role. We are looking for someone who brings an established network of LP relationships — family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, and institutions — and who can open doors, engage principals, and personally steward investors from first conversation through diligence to commitment.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

Beyond its core commerce platform, Xsolla is building a private credit fund that lends to video game studios and gaming businesses, underwritten with a data advantage no traditional lender has: Xsolla's own payments telemetry across thousands of games. The fund is in its capital formation phase and is led by Stan Rudoi, Chief Credit Officer. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help raise a first-time fund inside a profitable, global gaming-commerce company, alongside the broader Xsolla capital markets ecosystem (Xsolla Funding Club, Xsolla SPAC 1 — Nasdaq: XSLLU, and other strategic vehicles).

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

    LP Relationships and Origination

  • Bring and grow the network: activate your existing LP relationships and originate new ones across family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, and institutions.
  • Engage principals: represent the fund credibly with decision-makers and investment committees, and match opportunities to each investor's mandate and ticket size.
  • Source and qualify the wider funnel: from conferences, investor databases, introductions, Xsolla contacts, and external research — qualified and prioritized by mandate fit.
  • Steward each relationship through diligence, negotiation, and commitment — and after the close, as the foundation of the fund's long-term LP base.

    • Follow-Through and Pipeline Discipline

  • Drive follow-through from first contact to meeting, diligence, soft interest, and closed commitment — no lead goes stale.
  • Prepare and send investor outreach and follow-ups; capture meeting notes, next steps, and commitment tracking after every interaction.
  • Maintain clean CRM reporting: pipeline status, activity, outcomes, blockers, priorities, and weekly progress — so leadership always knows conversion rates, stage aging, and next actions per LP.
  • Provide regular internal fund progress reporting to Xsolla leadership via Slack and other internal tools. A junior IR hire will take on pipeline operations as the raise scales.

    • Fundraising Materials and Messaging

  • Support and continuously improve investor materials: pitch deck, FAQs, data room, and meeting-specific talking points.
  • Refine LP messaging, fund thesis, objection handling, and investor segmentation based on live market feedback.
  • Write concise, institutional-quality investor emails, follow-ups, and presentation language.

    • Diligence and Fund Setup Support

  • Coordinate LP diligence requests across internal Xsolla teams, external advisors, legal, finance, and leadership.
  • Support fund setup workstreams: data room preparation and upkeep, reporting readiness, and document management.
  • Collect and synthesize investor feedback on fund terms, structure, risk-return profile, reporting, and allocation preferences to inform fund design.

    • Cross-Product Fundraising Support

  • As capacity allows, extend the same funnel discipline and materials support to other Xsolla investment products and strategic vehicles, in coordination with the Capital Markets team.

Qualifications and Skills

    Experience

  • 7+ years in investor relations, placement, private funds, investment banking, private credit, venture capital, private equity, family office, or institutional fundraising.
  • An established, referenceable network of LP relationships — family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, or institutions — that you can activate for a first-time fund. This is the core requirement for the role.
  • A track record of raising institutional capital, with a strong understanding of LP fundraising mechanics: fund materials, diligence processes, investor segmentation, and the private fund lifecycle.
  • Direct exposure to private credit or first-time fund raises is a strong plus.

    • Skills and Competencies

  • Excellent business English; able to write concise investor emails, follow-ups, FAQs, and presentation language without supervision.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets, CRM, tracking, reporting, and project management discipline.
  • Commercial, structured, responsive, and able to manage many parallel investor conversations without dropping threads.
  • The gravitas and credibility to engage principals, investment committees, and senior allocators as a peer.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive fund and investor information.
  • Interest in gaming, fintech, private credit, alternative investments, or digital platforms preferred.

    • Education and Credentials

  • A bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field is preferred.
  • CFA / CAIA or relevant securities licenses are viewed favorably but not required.

Benefits

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act.

Criminal History Consideration

For the Head of Investor Relations – Credit Fundposition, we will conduct a background check that may include the following:

  • Criminal history check
  • Employment verification
  • Education verification
  • Credit history check

Relevance to Job Responsibilities

The background check is relevant to this position because of the following role responsibilities:

  • Handling sensitive financial information and supporting fund analytics, financial models, and deal data
  • Accessing confidential company data

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

We have an immediate opening for a Growth Development Representative. Reporting to our VP of Product, you'll be the bridge between our product-led growth motion and enterprise sales. As one of our first GDR hires, you'll have a rare opportunity to shape, optimize, automate, and grow the GDR function at Cube — a brave listener willing to test a wide range of ideas to deliver more signups and qualified meetings to our sales team.

  • Hit a quarterly target of qualified meetings sourced from our range of inbound channels — paid and organic, free (PLG) signups, and open-source users.

  • Continually optimize target audiences, sales cadences, and pitches for the best results.

  • Run outreach across a mix of traditional and new channels — email, phone, LinkedIn, AI — and keep testing new methods and messaging.

  • Improve GDR efficiency by bringing in and implementing new tools.

  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to creatively improve conversion from top-of-funnel interest into the sales funnel.

  • Give consistent visibility into sales-development activity, hand-offs, dispositions, KPIs, and outcomes by region, team, and individual.

  • Maintain and improve the data quality of leads and contacts in the CRM — opportunity detail, contact and account data, and call/meeting history.

  • Constantly seek new target audiences to bring into the funnel while converting existing interest (free signups, OSS users, and other inbound leads).

Who you are

  • A highly motivated, disciplined self-starter with strong interpersonal skills and excellent written, verbal, listening, and presentation skills.

  • Metrics-driven, with an analytical approach to solving business problems and reviewing and reporting on KPIs.

  • Experienced building multi-threaded campaigns across mid-market and enterprise organizations.

  • Creative and strategic in how you generate qualified leads.

  • Comfortable interacting with stakeholders across multiple departments.

  • Enterprise sales experience, ideally with exposure to (or genuine interest in) the data/analytics industry.

  • Familiar with sales prospecting tools such as Attio, Apollo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
