jobs.title: Technical Customer Success & Deployment Lead | Contract | Remote US
jobs.excerpt: About us:Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger.
jobs.description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for a Technical Customer Success & Deployment Lead for a project based assignment to turn committed pilots and customer deployments into successful implementations, measurable adoption, and long-term product value.
This is a customer-facing, enterprise-oriented role that sits at the intersection of customer success, implementation, technical delivery, product, and engineering.
You will own the operating relationship once an opportunity becomes a committed pilot or deployment. That includes onboarding, readiness, implementation planning, stakeholder coordination, adoption, issue triage, escalations, and ensuring customer feedback makes its way back into the product organization.
This is not a traditional support role or a quota-carrying sales position. You will be responsible for creating structure around complex customer deployments while protecting engineering teams from fragmented or unmanaged customer requests.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the customer operating cadence from pilot kickoff through deployment, adoption, and final pilot decision
  • Build and manage implementation plans, readiness checklists, milestones, dependencies, success criteria, and ownership matrices
  • Lead customer kickoffs and recurring deployment and status meetings
  • Coordinate dependencies across customers, GTM, Product, Partner Engineering, Security, Legal, and engineering delivery teams
  • Ensure each deployment has clear owners, timelines, risks, escalation paths, and measurable success criteria
  • Track customer usage, adoption, product health, risks, decisions, commitments, incidents, and follow-up actions
  • Surface blockers early and drive accountability across internal and external stakeholders
  • Triage customer issues into the appropriate category, including support, configuration, integration, product defect, roadmap request, or commercial discussion
  • Route technical and product issues to the correct internal owner with clear context and supporting information
  • Own customer-facing status updates and escalation communications during deployments and operational incidents
  • Help customers understand the distinction between existing product capabilities, configuration, integration work, and future roadmap items
  • Capture structured customer feedback and ensure Product and Engineering close the loop on decisions and learnings
  • Monitor customer health and adoption signals and identify risks to successful deployment or expansion
  • Develop reusable onboarding guides, implementation playbooks, runbooks, training materials, FAQs, and customer handoff processes
  • Drive pilots toward a clear outcome, including expand, convert, continue learning, pause, or exit

Required Skills:

  • Strong experience in enterprise technical customer success, implementation, solutions delivery, technical program management, or a similar customer-facing technical role
  • Experience working with platform, SaaS, API-driven, integration-heavy, or technical enterprise products
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex customer implementations or deployments from kickoff through production adoption
  • Strong ability to coordinate business, executive, product, engineering, security, and technical stakeholders
  • Experience creating and managing implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, ownership models, and escalation processes
  • Strong technical fluency with APIs, integrations, environments, system dependencies, and common software delivery concepts
  • Ability to understand and communicate technical issues without needing to be the engineer implementing the solution
  • Strong issue-triage skills and the ability to distinguish between configuration problems, integration issues, product defects, roadmap requests, and commercial concerns
  • Experience managing customer escalations and communicating clearly during high-pressure delivery or operational situations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders
  • Ability to turn ambiguous customer requests into structured, actionable information for Product and Engineering
  • Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail across multiple simultaneous customer commitments
  • Comfort working in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment where implementation and customer-success processes are still being developed

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting identity, security, infrastructure, DNS, registry, or other technically complex platform products
  • Experience working with enterprise API integrations
  • Experience supporting customer pilots, proofs of concept, or phased production rollouts
  • Familiarity with customer health metrics, adoption reporting, and implementation analytics
  • Experience working closely with solutions engineering, product management, and engineering teams
  • Experience building customer onboarding or implementation processes from the ground up
  • Familiarity with security, compliance, and enterprise procurement processes
  • Experience supporting strategic enterprise customers with complex organizational structures

What Success Looks Like
Within your first several months, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable pilot and deployment process with clear plans, ownership, milestones, risks, and escalation paths
  • Created standardized kickoff, readiness, RACI, success-measurement, and deployment templates
  • Brought visibility to active deployments, adoption, risks, issues, and customer health
  • Established a consistent operating cadence for priority customers and pilots
  • Improved the quality and structure of issues routed to Product and Engineering
  • Reduced fragmented customer requests and unnecessary interruptions to engineering teams
  • Created reusable onboarding, training, handoff, and deployment materials
  • Established a structured customer-feedback loop into Product and Engineering
  • Helped customers reach first value more predictably
  • Ensured pilots conclude with clear evidence and an explicit decision on whether to expand, convert, continue learning, pause, or exit

  • Contract

About the role...

As an TechnicalAccounts Quality Lead - BS&O, you’ll focus on preparing and reviewing complex financial statements & working papers for BS&O engagements, ensuring accuracy, technical compliance, and readiness for onshore teams ahead of client meetings and delivery. Your focus will be primarily on complex accounts consisting of those prepared under IFRS and Consolidated accounts.

This role sits firmly within our Business Services & Outsourcing offering, supporting the delivery of high-quality accounts and supporting working papers across multiple client types - from owner-managed businesses to growing groups. Your focus will be on ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, and technically compliant, while being practical and fit for purpose for client use.

A key part of this role is overseeing the technical accuracy and quality of outputs, ensuring all adjustments are justified and required and ensuring UK GAAP and Companies Act compliant.

About the day to day...

You'll be getting stuck into a diverse range of tasks and responsibilities, including;

  • Preparation & Review of statutory financial statements prepared under FRS 102/FRS 102 1A & IFRS with a focus on complex consolidated financial statements
  • Monitoring work flows to ensure on time delivery
  • Reviewing supporting working papers to ensure they are clear, complete, and client-ready
  • Ensuring balances are fully supported and reconciled to underlying records
  • Checking disclosures and presentation for accuracy and consistency
  • Applying a practical, commercial approach to financial reporting
  • Providing clear, actionable feedback to preparers to enable continuous improvement of service
  • Working closely with the Accounts Pod and onshore teams to support delivery in a streamlined, pro-active manner.
  • Identifying recurring issues and support improvements in templates and processes
  • Ensuring outputs are suitable for client use, tax compliance, and future periods

The role will also be designed to help you grow and develop through your career journey. With access to a wide range of knowledge to help push yourself further - from Managers to Partners, the team are always happy to support you.

About you...

At Cooper Parry, we’re in it together. All we ask of our people is that they play all in. You’ll continuously strive to keep learning – whether you’re a trainee or a Partner – and you’ll be brave, stepping out of your comfort zone to tackle new challenges. Above all, be nice. A simple notion, but an irreplaceable part of what makes CP, CP.

In addition to those core values, as a Technical Accounts Quality Lead you should have;

  • CA (SA) qualification
  • Minimum 4 years’ accounting experience
  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS, FRS 102, and consolidation accounting
  • Proven ability to oversee and ensure the quality of complex financial reporting deliverables
  • Previous experience in team management
  • Proficient in drafting financial statements in Caseware
  • Previous experience in a management accounting and balance sheet reconciliations (desirable)
  • Sound knowledge of debits, credits and accounting adjustments.
  • Previous experience using Inflo to obtain Client information (desirable)
  • Ability to identify technical disclosure issues
  • Previous bookkeeping or financial statement preparation & review experience
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience working with remote or international teams (desirable)
  • UK tax experience is advantageous

About us...

We’ve been dubbed ‘the rebels of accountancy’. We’re straight-talking. Never afraid to share our opinions. We put people and relationships before products and services, and deliver a streamlined, client-focused service – free from unnecessary red tape.

Check out our recent achievements:

  • Best Companies’No.1 Accountancy Firm & No.30 Best Large Company to Work For in the UK
  • Became B CorpCertified in 2023 and we’re still the UK’s largest accountancy B Corp, measuring and improving our impact beyond business for a brighter tomorrow
  • Achieved 5 awards at the Inspiring Workplace Awards in 2025: winner in the Large Business category and best in class for inspiring People & Culture, Wellbeing, Inclusion and Employee Experience

What's in it for you?

Our people are the beating heart of our culture. We know that if you love working here, and you’re given the trust and autonomy to work in a way that best suits you, you’ll produce amazing results.

That’s why we offer things like:

  • A generous holiday entitlement

  • Volunteering opportunities to work closer with local communities and charities

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. You will work closely with project owners, solution architects, QA engineers, and technical leads to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions for our clients.

  • Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments.

jobs.excerpt: Pearl Talent - Psychometrician We're hiring a Psychometrician for Pearl, which finds exceptional talent from around the world, trains them to be AI-native, and places them into operational roles at startups as managed contractors: from client-facing roles to software engineers to executive assistants.
jobs.description:
Pearl Talent - Psychometrician

We're hiring a Psychometrician for Pearl, which finds exceptional talent from around the world, trains them to be AI-native, and places them into operational roles at startups as managed contractors: from client-facing roles to software engineers to executive assistants. We're 3x founders who've bootstrapped our company to a couple million in ARR and are adding six to seven figures in net new annualized revenue each month. Our clients span venture-backed tech and healthcare, including fast-growing startups and phenomenal US-based businesses that have raised over $3B in funding from Sequoia, a16z, Founders Fund, Y Combinator, and other top VC firms.

Today we're roughly 50 people managing a few hundred talents, growing fast and into new verticals. We started Pearl because we believe that even though opportunity isn't created equal in the world, ambitious talent is.

Location: Fully remote

Purpose of Your Role

You'll be the scientific backbone of our AI voice-model initiative. We're building a model that infers psychological constructs from voice, and its quality will only ever be as good as the measurement system behind it.

This is not a machine-learning engineering role. You won't build the model itself. Instead, you'll define what we should measure, design and validate the instruments that measure it, and convert those measurements into defensible ground-truth labels and evaluation criteria for model training. You'll also be the person in the room with the authority — and the responsibility — to say what voice can't responsibly tell us about a person.

What You'll Own

1. The Psychometric Framework

  • Review the literature and evaluate established frameworks (Big Five/OCEAN, HEXACO, DISC, and other relevant models) for validity, usefulness, and fit for our use case
  • Recommend which constructs and dimensions to include, exclude, or treat cautiously — and explicitly identify traits that cannot be responsibly inferred from voice
  • Build and maintain a clear construct map connecting constructs, dimensions, indicators, survey items, and resulting scores, documented as the single source of truth for Research, Data, and AI teams

2. Instrument Design and Validation

  • Design psychometric surveys that serve as a high-quality measurement source for participants who also provide voice samples: items, response scales, scoring rules, reverse-coded items, and attention checks, while minimizing fatigue and response bias
  • Decide when to use validated existing scales, adapt them, or develop fit-for-purpose measures — then pilot and iterate based on empirical performance
  • Run the full validation battery: reliability (McDonald's omega, Cronbach's alpha, item-total analysis), EFA and CFA to test dimensional structure, construct/convergent/discriminant/criterion validity, test-retest where appropriate, and IRT where useful
  • Recommend sample sizes, pilot methodology, and evidence thresholds a measure must clear before it's used for training

3. Ground Truth and Model Evaluation

  • Partner with AI and Data teams to transform psychometric responses into defensible training labels: continuous scores, categories, normalization, and confidence/reliability information
  • Define rules for missing, inconsistent, or low-quality responses, and the criteria for when a label is reliable enough to train on
  • Design the framework for comparing survey-based ground truth against voice-model predictions, and define evaluation metrics that reflect psychometric validity — not just ML performance
  • Analyze where the model performs well, where it fails, and whether prediction quality differs by construct or population

4. Bias, Fairness, and Scientific Guardrails

  • Evaluate measurement invariance and potential bias across languages, cultures, and populations, including the impact of translation and sampling choices
  • Define the scientific limits around what conclusions may and may not be drawn from voice-based predictions, and partner with Product and AI to prevent unsupported or misleading interpretations
  • Translate complex statistical findings into practical decisions for technical and non-technical stakeholders, keeping methodology aligned with current peer-reviewed research

What Success Looks Like

Within your first cycle, the full measurement pipeline runs through you: framework selected, construct map built, Survey V1 designed and piloted, statistically validated, refined into Survey V2, and converted into a scoring system that produces training labels the AI team trusts. When the voice model ships predictions, they're validated against ground truth you built — and every claim the product makes about a person is one your framework can scientifically defend.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (MSc or PhD preferred) in Psychometrics, Quantitative Psychology, Psychological Measurement, I/O Psychology, Behavioral Science, or a closely related quantitative field
  • Hands-on instrument experience. You've designed, validated, and refined psychometric instruments yourself — not just used them
  • A strong statistical foundation in factor analysis, reliability, validity, and measurement theory; IRT experience is a strong plus
  • Comfort with messy, real-world data. You can work with imperfect behavioral datasets and still make evidence-based recommendations
  • Cross-functional fluency. You're comfortable collaborating with AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and product teams; Python or R experience is highly desirable
  • Scientific backbone. You'll challenge unsupported assumptions, define responsible limits for AI-based psychological inference, and hold the line when it matters

Benefits

  • Build and Grow Quickly - We’re scaling fast, and we trust that you’ll know best on the ground what needs to be done. You’ll have the opportunity to step into leadership early and own decisions that shape how our company grows.
  • Fully Remote. Forever. - We’ve built Pearl with a multicultural DNA and teammates across 23 countries. We trust that the best work isn’t done behind a cubicle
  • Unlimited PTO - We trust that you’ll get your work done, and we want to create space for you to take time away with the people you care about.
  • Global Retreats - We create space for our teammates to get to know each other as people, rather than just to-do lists. We’ve shared meals, laughs, and sunrises across the world in places like Cancun, El Nido, Boracay, and Siargao**.**
  • Ambitious and Kind Team - We build with the most competent people we know, and we maintain a low-ego, no-assholes policy. We’re looking for people who are sharp, kind, and open to being vulnerable when it matters.

jobs.title: Head of AI Safety
jobs.excerpt: Moonshot believes that marginalised people in society — including minority ethnic people, people from working class backgrounds, women, Disabled and LGBTQIA+ people — must be centred in the work we do.
jobs.description:
Moonshot believes that marginalised people in society — including minority ethnic people, people from working class backgrounds, women, Disabled and LGBTQIA+ people — must be centred in the work we do. We strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other communities who are currently underrepresented in our workforce. We know a diverse workforce will enable us to understand drivers behind violent extremism and online harms in an in-depth way and do better work to counter them.

About the role

Moonshot is recruiting a Head of AI Safety to lead the delivery, development, and growth of our AI Safety portfolio. The role combines Moonshot's expertise in violence prevention, behavioural risk, and online harms with the emerging practice of evaluating and improving the safety of AI systems. The portfolio addresses harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, child sexual exploitation, abuse and grooming (CSEA), mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teenagers.

The Head of AI Safety will serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI companies, governments, and regulators. The role will work closely with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams. This is not an engineering or data-science role, but it is a hands-on position requiring the successful candidate to lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with evaluation methodologies, test scenarios, model responses, safety policies, and intervention frameworks. The role holds responsibility for client and partner relationships, project and staff management, methodological quality, and business development. The Head of AI Safety will build and maintain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including with governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, and civil society organisations.

Your responsibilities will include:

Applied AI Safety, Evaluation, and Advisory

  • Lead and quality-assure Moonshot's applied AI safety work across harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, CSEA, abuse and grooming, mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teens, using methods such as red teaming and adversarial evaluation of AI systems.
  • Advise frontier AI companies on how to improve the safety of their models, products, policies, and intervention systems.
  • Translate insights from psychologists, child-safety specialists, violence-prevention practitioners, safeguarding experts, and other subject-matter experts into clear, actionable guidance for model safety, policy, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Set the methodological approach for the portfolio, translating violence-prevention, safeguarding, and behavioural-risk expertise into structured and testable evaluation frameworks.
  • Lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with test scenarios, model responses, scoring criteria, safety policies, and evaluation results.
  • Identify patterns, edge cases, and potential safety failures, and develop practical recommendations for improving model behaviour and user protections.
  • Maintain rigour and clear documentation across the team's technical deliverables, suitable for technical, government, and foundation audiences.
  • Ensure work is delivered within a clear ethical framework and in compliance with contractual, legal, data protection, and ethics obligations.
  • Identify, manage, and escalate operational, reputational, delivery, and partnership risks.

Client & Partner Management

  • Serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI company partners, governments, regulators, and the wider ecosystem invested in AI safety.
  • Build trusted relationships with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Build and sustain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, civil society organisations, and specialist practitioners.
  • Represent Moonshot externally in meetings, briefings, workshops, and sector engagement, including with regulators and policymaker audiences.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Provide direct leadership, coaching, and management to Moonshot's AI safety team.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team culture, with particular attention to wellbeing given the sensitive nature of the work.
  • Support workforce planning, performance management, and professional development across the team.
  • Ensure effective coordination with internal teams supporting the portfolio, including operations, finance, research, and technical teams.

Portfolio Development & Growth

  • Develop Moonshot's AI safety portfolio, identifying strategic opportunities, partnerships, and funding.
  • Lead proposal development, scoping, and renewals with technical credibility, using precise, defensible language suited to technical and government audiences.
  • Develop repeatable methodologies, service offerings, and partnerships that allow the portfolio to grow while maintaining methodological rigour and delivery quality.
  • Support external communications, publications, briefings, and thought leadership that establish Moonshot as a credible voice in applied AI safety.
  • Oversee project planning, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Experience in trust & safety, online harms, or a closely related field such as violence prevention, safeguarding, or public health, and the ability to adapt that knowledge to AI systems.
  • Curiosity about AI and the ability to build technical fluency quickly, enough to engage credibly with technical counterparts at AI companies. Much of this work is new, so comfort learning as you go matters more than existing AI safety expertise.
  • Experience designing research, evaluation frameworks, or interventions for harm categories such as violent extremism, CSEA, self-harm and crisis, or targeted violence.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects, teams, budgets, partners, and clients, with strong people management skills.
  • Excellent written communication, with experience producing credible (not promotional) material for government, foundation, or enterprise audiences.
  • Comfort and demonstrated resilience working with highly sensitive or graphic content (CSEA, extremist material, crisis content), with awareness of wellbeing practices for this kind of work.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and sensitive stakeholder environments, including representing organisations externally.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside regular hours where needed to accommodate clients or respond to incidents.
  • Highly trustworthy, with discretion and diplomacy, and willing to undertake relevant security clearance procedures.
  • Experience supporting business development, grant funding, or procurement.
  • Commitment to Moonshot's mission.
  • We require and will check candidates' eligibility to work in the UK and pass any relevant security clearance procedures per the needs of clients.

Desirable:

  • Direct experience in model safety, red teaming, or adversarial evaluation of LLMs or other AI systems.
  • Understanding of LLM architecture, safety tooling, or trust & safety policy.
  • Prior experience in child safety evaluation, teen-safety product work, or grooming and CSEA detection.
  • Familiarity with government or regulatory engagement, such as briefing officials or supporting policy submissions.
  • Experience with intervention or diversion programme design that can transfer to AI-mediated interventions.
  • Academic or applied background in radicalisation studies, forensic psychology, or violence risk assessment.
  • Familiarity with taxonomy or classifier development, including how testing data feeds a classifier.

Benefits

  • 30 days' paid annual leave, excluding public holidays.
  • Flexible public holiday policy with the option to work public holidays in exchange for a day off at another time.
  • Private healthcare package with access to specialist mental health cover, including coverage for partners and children.
  • Dental and Vision Insurance.
  • Life Insurance & Income Protection.
  • Employee Assistance Programme providing access to mental health support.
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave: 26 weeks paid maternity leave, 8 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • All permanent employees are granted share options upon employment.

Salary: €78,000 - €92,000 (depending on skills and experience).

jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARY The Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs is a strategic leader within FHI 360, responsible for the technical leadership and strategic direction of strategic information, monitoring, evaluation, analytics, data systems, and learning (SI/MEL) across the Health Programs (HP) portfolio within the Programs and Research Group (PRG).
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs is a strategic leader within FHI 360, responsible for the technical leadership and strategic direction of strategic information, monitoring, evaluation, analytics, data systems, and learning (SI/MEL) across the Health Programs (HP) portfolio within the Programs and Research Group (PRG). This role provides technical and operational oversight to a division comprised of multiple project SI/MEL teams, fosters innovation, and ensures the delivery of high-quality, timely, and actionable data aligned with organizational objectives and donor requirements. The Senior Director establishes and continually refines SI/MEL frameworks, approaches, tools, and activities; identifies specialized partnership needs; and engages qualified partners to ensure technical performance. Working across FHI 360 Health Programs projects and country portfolios, the Senior Director strengthens the integration of surveillance, MEL, data management, analytics, and digital health systems, in close collaboration with project SI/MEL leadership teams to ensure coherence, technical alignment, and mutual learning across initiatives. The Senior Director collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to gather and share evidence, lessons learned, and best practices to drive continuous improvement and organizational impact. They also provide business analytics to maintain and expand market share in the relevant domain and represent FHI 360 as a thought leader in strategic information, health informatics, and data-driven program improvement. Engagement with country and field teams is exercised primarily through project SI/MEL leadership; direct, hands-on support to field teams is expected on bilateral awards and is provided to global projects at the request of project leadership. Their decisions are guided by organizational strategy and have significant short- and long-term impacts on public health and development outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES

Complexity & Problem Solving:

  • Navigates complex and technically demanding SI/MEL challenges inherent in project implementation, requiring innovative approaches and deep analytical skills.

  • Offers strategic direction and innovative SI/MEL solutions for portfolio-specific challenges.

  • Analyzes project performance against indicator targets, data quality assessments, and portfolio-level trends, and identifies areas for improvement.

  • Recommends actionable solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency.

  • Fosters innovation and shares best practices to drive organizational impact.

  • Contributes to achieving sustainable development goals.

  • Resolves methodological and measurement problems that cross awards — conflicting indicator definitions, non-comparable denominators, data quality gaps, and evaluation design trade-offs — and sets the technical standard to be applied across the portfolio.

  • Strengthens institutional data governance, interoperability, and integration of information systems, including DHIS2, EMRs, LMIS, and custom databases.

  • Ensures project data systems meet donor reporting standards (e.g., DATIM, DIS, DHIS2, MER indicators) and support programmatic decision-making at all levels.

Discretion & Impact:

  • Exercises discretion over SI/MEL technical and methodological matters with direct impact on project outcomes and organizational success.

  • Makes decisions on resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Influences portfolio performance and reputation.

  • Decisions contribute to achieving organizational objectives and driving positive change.

  • Impacts both short- and long-term public health outcomes.

  • Sets and enforces portfolio-wide SI/MEL technical standards; erroneous methodological or reporting decisions may result in inaccurate performance reporting to donors, audit findings, or critical delays in schedules.

  • Provides strategic insights that directly inform organizational strategy and programmatic priorities.

Collaboration & Interaction:

  • Engages with internal and external stakeholders to gather and share evidence, lessons learned, and best practices.

  • Fosters partnerships with project teams, donors, and implementing partners.

  • Facilitates communication and knowledge exchange to enhance project outcomes.

  • Communication style is characterized by transparency, collaboration, and teamwork.

  • Works cross-functionally to achieve common goals and drive organizational impact.

  • Establishes and maintains relationships across FHI 360, including with all Groups and Enterprise Support colleagues.

  • Serves as senior technical advisor to project leadership, to the SI/MEL Directors and Advisors assigned to FHI 360’s global health projects, and to headquarters management.

  • Provides high-level technical guidance on surveillance and data use for epidemic control, global health security, and cross-cutting health programs (HIV, TB, RMNCH, malaria, AMR, etc.).

  • Supports proposal development by providing SI/MEL technical input, writing relevant sections, and contributing to results frameworks; promotes knowledge management and learning by synthesizing lessons learned, disseminating best practices, and contributing to publications and conferences.

  • Builds capacity of FHI 360 technical teams and local partners in data management, visualization, and use of evidence for decision-making.

Management & Supervision:

  • Oversees SI/MEL implementation across the projects within their division.

  • Provides leadership and guidance to project teams.

  • Sets strategic direction, manages budgets, and ensures programmatic quality.

  • Focuses on fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

  • Manages project staff and shapes the portfolio structure for optimal efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Leads a team of seasoned technical experts, handling supervision, performance management, and professional development.

  • Embraces other duties as assigned, contributing to the team’s multifaceted and evolving responsibilities.

  • Provides matrixed, dotted-line technical oversight of the SI/MEL Directors of FHI 360’s global health projects, who continue to report administratively to their respective project leadership; sets technical performance expectations for these roles and contributes to their performance reviews in coordination with their line managers.

  • Delineates portfolio- and project-level roles: project SI/MEL Directors remain accountable for award-specific deliverables — work plans, PMPs, indicator definitions, donor reporting, and project data systems — while this position is accountable for cross-portfolio technical standards, methodological quality assurance, staffing and capacity, and the harmonization and comparability of SI/MEL approaches across awards.

  • Ensures that Health Programs projects are appropriately staffed and technically supported for SI/MEL: advises on SI/MEL staffing structures and levels of effort, participates in the recruitment and selection of senior SI/MEL positions, orients and onboards new SI/MEL staff, and mobilizes surge or specialist technical support when project needs exceed available capacity.

  • Where the position is costed to a bilateral award, or where a global project requests this support, assumes direct responsibility for the SI/MEL activities of that project, including contributing to the finalization and submission of project work plans, performance monitoring plans (PMPs), and quarterly, annual, and other reports. This is not a standing expectation across the portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of project management principles.

  • Expertise in program implementation methodologies.

  • Proficient in organizational leadership practices.

  • Demonstrates expertise in strategic planning, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Proven track record of driving innovation and achieving impactful outcomes within their division.

  • Aims to meet or exceed revenue targets across all segments (USG, foundations/corporations, and other donors).

  • Demonstrated expertise in strategic information, MEL, surveillance, and data analytics in large, complex public health or development programs.

  • Strong technical command of quantitative and qualitative methods, data visualization, and the use of digital tools (DHIS2, Power BI, Tableau).

  • Knowledge of global health and development programming, particularly in global health security, infectious diseases, maternal and child health, and health systems strengthening.

  • Excellent oral and written communication and analytical skills in English.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or its International Equivalent in Business Administration, International Development, Civil Society, Communication, Social Marketing, Economic Development, Education, Environment, Gender, Health, Nutrition, Research, Technology, Youth, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in project management, overseeing complex projects and initiatives; or 12 years and a master’s degree; or 9 years and a PhD; or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience to perform job responsibilities effectively.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in leadership and line management.

  • Proven experience leading and managing complex, strategic portfolios of programs/projects on a national or international scale.

  • Experience leading teams in complex settings, managing financial and human resources.

  • Significant experience working in non-governmental organizations (NGOs).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a related field.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or other recognized project management certification.

  • Certifications relevant to research management or organizational leadership.

  • We welcome candidates with other relevant certifications or their international equivalents.

TRAVEL

Approximately 25% travel may be required for this role, primarily to engage with stakeholders, oversee project implementation, and attend meetings and events related to portfolio activities.

TYPICAL PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Typical office environment. Constantly uses a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

TECHNOLOGY

Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Voice AI
jobs.excerpt: About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

For most SMBs, the phone remains one of the highest-intent customer channels. A call may represent a new lead, an urgent service request, a customer trying to book an appointment, a patient looking for help, a buyer asking a final question, or an existing customer who needs immediate support. When the call goes unanswered, the opportunity is often lost.

Most SMBs cannot staff every phone line, department, location, and language around the clock. Traditional IVRs frustrate callers, outsourced answering services lack business context, and human teams spend significant time handling repetitive conversations. HighLevel's Voice AI product is designed to change that.

Voice AI enables businesses to deploy intelligent phone agents that can answer inbound calls, initiate outbound calls, understand caller intent, hold natural conversations, answer questions from business knowledge, qualify leads, collect structured information, book appointments, trigger workflows, interact with external systems, route callers between specialised AI agents, transfer calls to humans, and complete follow-up actions.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define and lead the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy, architecture, quality bar, evaluation system, commercial model, and operating metrics required to make Voice AI dependable across millions of real-world phone conversations.

This is not a prompt-management or chatbot-feature role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role requiring deep systems thinking across AI, voice, telephony, automation, CRM, reliability, compliance, and business outcomes. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, make platform-level trade-offs, and establish Voice AI as one of the most trusted and commercially important products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Voice AI.
  • Own the complete Voice AI lifecycle, including agent creation, prompts, system instructions, voice and model selection, knowledge, actions, testing, deployment, phone routing, inbound and outbound calling, transfers, analytics, permissions, APIs, billing, and optimisation.
  • Establish the product principles that determine when a Voice AI agent should answer, ask a clarifying question, retrieve knowledge, take an action, transfer to another agent, transfer to a human, schedule follow-up, or end the call.
  • Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, franchises, multi-location businesses, and call-intensive industries such as home services, healthcare and wellness, legal, real estate, automotive, insurance, financial services, fitness, hospitality, and professional services.
  • Personally review real call recordings, transcripts, latency traces, action logs, failed calls, support tickets, customer configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into strategic choices, product requirements, system models, phased roadmaps, quality standards, and measurable success criteria.
  • Partner closely with engineering and AI leadership on streaming architecture, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice activity detection, turn detection, interruption handling, LLM orchestration, tool invocation, context management, retrieval, caching, latency, reliability, model selection, and cost.
  • Partner closely with Phone System and infrastructure teams on call routing, number provisioning, carrier integrations, Twilio and LC Phone behaviour, recording, transfers, forwarding, voicemail, call status, and telephony failure modes.
  • Establish a scalable evaluation and release framework for model, prompt, voice, retrieval, action, routing, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define production service expectations across call-answer rates, connection success, response latency, audio quality, uptime, action reliability, transfer reliability, and graceful degradation.
  • Partner with Design to simplify agent creation, voice selection, prompt configuration, testing, deployment, debugging, analytics, optimisation, and reuse.
  • Make Prompt Evaluator, Edit with AI, Prompt Optimiser, Web Call testing, phone testing, and production logs part of a coherent agent-quality workflow.
  • Improve integrations between Voice AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Knowledge Base, Payments, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, Phone System, and Reporting.
  • Define the architecture and customer experience for multi-agent transfers, human transfers, context handoffs, specialist reuse, fallback behaviour, and merged post-call outputs.
  • Develop observability and debugging experiences that expose call state, latency, transcripts, retrieved knowledge, model behaviour, tool calls, parameter extraction, action responses, transfers, carrier errors, and execution timelines.
  • Define instrumentation across the full funnel, including agent creation, configuration completion, first test, first successful test, number assignment, first live call, first successful action, sustained usage, business outcomes, retention, and expansion.
  • Define operational metrics for inbound and outbound Voice AI, distinguishing between dialling, connection, conversation, qualification, execution, transfer, and business-outcome success.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and Security on consent, disclosures, voice cloning, recording, data processing, retention, outbound calling, sensitive information, fraud, abuse, and platform safeguards.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, competitive differentiation, customer education, vertical templates, launches, and agency enablement.
  • Partner with Support, Implementation, Account Management, Trial Experience, Affiliates, and agency-facing teams to reduce setup friction, improve deployment quality, and lower support burden.
  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on pricing, included usage, overages, agency rebilling, model costs, telephony costs, gross margin, budget protection, and sustainable commercial limits.
  • Drive strategy across the broader AI Employee portfolio so Voice AI works coherently with Conversation AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Ask AI, Workflows, Calendars, and future AI-agent capabilities.
  • Evaluate external models, voice providers, telephony vendors, infrastructure components, and potential strategic partnerships.
  • Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.
  • Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product strategy, AI evaluation, systems thinking, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, Voice AI, conversational AI, communications, contact-centre, telephony, CRM, workflow-automation, or AI-agent products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.
  • Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.
  • Evidence of defining strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained customer and commercial outcomes — not only shipping individual features.
  • Experience building or operating production AI-agent systems that interact with real customers and take actions inside business workflows.
  • Strong understanding of the difference between an impressive voice demonstration and a reliable production calling product.
  • Technical fluency across several of the following:

○ Speech-to-text and automatic speech recognition

○ Text-to-speech and voice models

○ Streaming audio

○ Voice activity and end-of-turn detection

○ Barge-in and interruption handling

○ Noise and echo cancellation

○ LLM orchestration and function calling

○ Context management and RAG/knowledge retrieval

○ APIs and webhooks

○ Telephony, PSTN, SIP, or carrier infrastructure

○ Latency, reliability, observability, and cost

  • Strong judgment around AI evaluation — able to define how voice agents should be tested, scored, monitored, debugged, and improved in production.
  • Strong systems thinking — able to connect phone infrastructure, AI models, voices, prompts, CRM data, calendars, workflows, actions, permissions, reporting, compliance, and billing into a coherent product.
  • Experience simplifying technically sophisticated systems for non-technical customers.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS and the operational requirements of agencies, franchises, resellers, or multi-location businesses.
  • Strong customer instincts and willingness to inspect recordings, transcripts, traces, failed calls, implementation issues, and support data personally.
  • Commercial judgment across activation, retention, packaging, usage-based pricing, provider cost, telephony cost, gross margin, and partner economics.
  • Ability to make difficult trade-offs between caller experience, latency, accuracy, reliability, extensibility, compliance, and cost.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and multiple teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Excellent written communication — able to produce clear strategy documents, product requirements, system models, evaluation plans, architectural decisions, executive updates, and launch narratives.
  • High ownership, intellectual honesty, and execution velocity in a remote-first, high-context environment.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building production voice agents, contact-centre AI, automated receptionists, sales dialers, or customer-service voice automation.
  • Experience with voice and AI platforms such as Twilio, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, Dialpad, RingCentral, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with PSTN, SIP, WebRTC, IVR, call routing, caller identification, number provisioning, recording, voicemail detection, and carrier failure modes.
  • Experience building real-time systems with strict latency and availability requirements.
  • Experience designing agent tools, function calling, MCP integrations, workflow actions, or external API execution.
  • Experience building automated evaluation systems using scenario generation, synthetic callers, human review, production telemetry, transcripts, recordings, and business-outcome data.
  • Experience with appointment scheduling, lead qualification, customer support, call routing, outbound campaigns, or service-dispatch products.
  • Experience supporting multilingual speech recognition and synthesis, accents, localisation, translation, pronunciation, or voice cloning.
  • Experience with consent, AI disclosure, call recording, opt-out management, outbound-contact rules, trust and safety, or communications-platform abuse prevention.
  • Experience building APIs, webhooks, developer platforms, reusable templates, marketplaces, or partner ecosystems.
  • Experience building products for agencies, SMBs, franchises, local businesses, or multi-location operators.
  • Experience with AI usage-based pricing, per-minute communication pricing, provider routing, model cost management, gross-margin optimisation, rebilling, or fair-use controls.
  • Familiarity with metrics such as call answer rate, connection rate, time to first response, end-of-turn latency, barge-in success, speech-recognition accuracy, call completion rate, containment rate, transfer success rate, action success rate, appointment-booking conversion, caller sentiment, opt-out and complaint rate, P95/P99 latency, cost per call, cost per successful outcome, retention, and support-ticket rate.

Why Join HighLevel?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director of Project Management to help us evolve our Project Management practice to scale along the growing needs of the organization - to build a team of PMs who own delivery end-to-end across our full customer base, a governance system that surfaces risk before it becomes an escalation, and an operating rhythm that makes “on track” a verifiable claim rather than a status update. You'll start by upleveling how we deliver our largest, most complex enterprise implementations, then build out how project management scales efficiently across the rest of our customer base. This is a builder role - you will establish project management as a first-class function here, not maintaining an existing one.

What You'll Do

    Own Delivery Governance Across the Full Portfolio

  • Serve as the single accountable owner for project governance across implementation segments, from our largest enterprise accounts to our highest-volume, scale-motion accounts.

  • Build and run a risk-visibility system — dashboard, thresholds, escalation triggers — that surfaces problems before they reach leadership, not after.

  • Define milestone gates for engagements at every scale, from high-touch enterprise builds to lighter-touch scale delivery, and hold the team accountable to them.

    • Build and Lead the PM Organization

  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of project managers and project coordinators; build a defined career path across levels and segments.

  • Own the standards this function runs on — best practices, change management, workflow documentation — and make sure they scale from our most complex accounts down to our highest-volume ones.

  • Design and build a project coordinator model to support scale delivery: milestone-based check-ins, AI-assisted monitoring, and a delivery model that can responsibly cover a high volume of concurrent projects per coordinator.

    • Raise the Bar on Enterprise Delivery

  • Partner with Architecture leadership to draw a clear line between system design ownership and project accountability ownership — and hold that line as the organization scales.

  • Diagnose and close the specific gaps that let complex projects run today without a single accountable owner.

    • Drive Operating Rhythm and Visibility

  • Run a recurring delivery forum reporting progress, risk, and change management status across segments.

  • Report delivery health, risk, and escalation trends to the VP of Technical Services and CX leadership on a defined cadence.

What You'll Need

  • Direct experience implementing enterprise SaaS within an internal delivery team or a partner organization (systems integrator, consulting firm, or implementation partner) — deep familiarity with the operational rigor enterprise buyers expect, independent of any single product.

  • Experience designing delivery models that work at more than one scale — you've built or run both high-touch, complex delivery and higher-volume, lighter-touch delivery, and know how those operating models differ.

  • A demonstrated track record of building a PM function or operating system where one didn't previously exist, or was under-resourced — not just operating inside an already-mature one.

  • Comfortable being the accountable owner of a project's outcome without owning the technical solution — this is an operational and stakeholder-management role, not an architecture role.

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience with incentive compensation management (ICM) or a similarly complex, configuration-heavy enterprise software category.

  • Experience designing or scaling a project coordinator / delivery-ops model for a high-volume, lower-touch customer segment.

Benefits

  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.

Strategic Sr. Business Analyst - Cloud Expertise

GDIT is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst with strong strategic analysis, enterprise planning, and delivery-focused functional analysis expertise to support our PPS Modernization Program. This role blends high‑level strategic capability with deep hands-on functional analysis needed for large-scale modernization, cloud migration, and process transformation initiatives.

Role Overview
The Senior Business Analyst serves as a strategic advisor, translating executive priorities into actionable roadmaps while ensuring functional requirements for complex IT systems are fully defined, analyzed, and validated. This position operates across both strategic planning and system delivery workstreams—shaping early-phase initiatives, conducting business and capability modeling, and driving requirements through the full modernization lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis & Enterprise Planning

  • Collaborate with executive stakeholders to define business problems, strategic objectives, and high-level solution approaches for modernization.
    • Develop and present business cases, including business process automation, analysis, and recommendations.
    • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Product Strategy, and Portfolio Governance teams to create and maintain strategic roadmaps.
    • Evaluate business processes at the macro level using enterprise capability mapping, value stream analysis, and process decomposition.
    • Facilitate strategic workshops, decision forums, and prioritization sessions with senior leadership.
    • Shape the initial scope, objectives, and success criteria for new modernization initiatives before transition to delivery teams.
    • Ensure alignment between strategy, technology, modernization goals, and organizational priorities.
  • Provide expert guidance to clients recommending functional and strategic improvements.
    • Deliver recommendations, analyses, and briefings to senior-level stakeholders.
    • Operate effectively in ambiguous environments and shape early-phase initiatives into actionable plans.

Functional Analysis & Delivery Support

  • Analyze user needs to determine functional requirements for a wide variety of projects and highlights areas of improvement.
  • Utilize advanced, highly complex modeling and measuring techniques. Performs functional modeling based on requirements analysis.
    • Direct functional testing of various projects or systems.
    • Research, identify, and recommend resources required for task execution and completion.
    • Develop new functionality or updates the existing, to meet client needs.
    • Write and update project documentation including procedures, presentations, and training materials.
    • Perform functional allocations to identify tasks and their inter-relationships.
    • Consult with clients to determine optimum design for assigned projects.
    • May provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced analysts.
    • May serve as a mentor to less experienced analysts.
    • May serve as team or task lead. (Not a people manager)
    • Serve as advisor to clients in assigned subject areas, recommends functional changes, and identifies areas for further investigation.
    • Generate recommendations in the form of briefings, reports, and other major documents provided to senior level client personnel.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience, including at least 8 years specialized in IT system functional analysis, preferably supporting cloud or large-scale modernization efforts.
    • Demonstrated experience in strategic analysis, enterprise planning, or business consulting.
    • Superior functional knowledge of modernization programs and complex, integrated IT systems.
    • Strong analytical abilities (market research, financial analysis, modeling, capability assessments).
    • Expertise in defining, documenting, and managing complex business rules.
    • Experience using Agile tools and processes, including Jira.
    • Ability to communicate complex strategy and functional concepts to senior stakeholders.
    • Knowledge of enterprise business architecture, capability models, and portfolio management.

• BS degree in an IT-related field.

• Experience in zCloud and AWS/Azure Cloud Modernization.

• Experience in Agile methodology for modernization initiatives.

jobs.description:
Animator / Motion Graphics Designer

Motion Graphics | Animation | Video Editing | Creative Design

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, Costa Rica
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a creative and execution-focused Animator / Motion Graphics Designer to produce engaging visual content for brand campaigns, digital marketing, social media, and product storytelling.

This role is responsible for transforming creative ideas, scripts, and briefs into polished animations and motion graphics that strengthen brand presence and drive engagement across digital platforms.

You’ll work closely with creative, marketing, and video teams to produce compelling visual experiences through motion design, animation, typography, and storytelling.

This is more than a video editing role. We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for motion, pacing, and modern digital content who can combine creativity with technical execution while delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

If you’re passionate about creating motion content that captures attention and delivers measurable impact, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Own

Motion Graphics & Animation Production

  • Create 2D and 3D animations, kinetic typography, and motion graphics for marketing campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and branded content.
  • Develop animations for explainer videos, product demonstrations, social media campaigns, reels, and digital advertising assets.
  • Transform storyboards and creative concepts into engaging motion experiences.
  • Design transitions, visual effects, and animated sequences aligned with campaign objectives.
  • Deliver visually compelling, modern animations optimized for engagement across platforms.

Creative Collaboration & Brand Execution

  • Collaborate with graphic designers, video editors, marketers, and creative leads.
  • Ensure all motion assets align with brand guidelines and messaging.
  • Contribute creative concepts, animation styles, and storytelling ideas during campaign planning.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining creative quality and consistency.
  • Support multiple campaigns with efficient turnaround times.

Video Editing & Multimedia Integration

  • Edit motion-based video content using Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
  • Integrate music, voiceovers, sound effects, and audio into animated projects.
  • Combine footage, graphics, animation, and visual assets into polished deliverables.
  • Produce short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

Asset Management & Optimization

  • Export assets optimized for web, social media, paid advertising, presentations, and broadcast.
  • Maintain organized project files, templates, plugins, and animation libraries.
  • Ensure assets remain scalable, editable, and reusable.
  • Optimize content for multiple aspect ratios and platform specifications.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current with animation trends, platform updates, and creative best practices.
  • Create content optimized for engagement, watch time, click-through rate (CTR), and campaign performance.
  • Continuously improve workflows, creative quality, and production efficiency.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of professional experience in:
    • Motion Graphics
    • Animation
    • Multimedia Design
  • Strong portfolio showcasing motion graphics, animations, branded content, or advertising work.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Motion design principles
    • Timing and pacing
    • Animation techniques
    • Visual storytelling
  • Experience creating motion content for marketing campaigns, digital advertising, or social media.
  • Familiarity with modern platform specifications and content optimization.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with:
    • Cinema 4D
    • Blender
    • Maya
    • Other 3D animation tools
  • Background in:
    • Advertising agencies
    • SaaS
    • Entertainment
    • E-learning
  • Experience with sound design and audio integration.
  • Understanding of marketing performance metrics such as CTR, engagement, and watch time.
  • Experience producing high-performing paid advertising creatives.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong visual storyteller with excellent motion design instincts.
  • Creative while maintaining brand consistency and quality.
  • Highly organized with excellent project management skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple deadlines and revision cycles.
  • Collaborative and communicative in remote environments.
  • Adaptable across multiple animation styles, formats, and creative requests.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review creative briefs and storyboard concepts.
  • Design and animate motion graphics for digital campaigns.
  • Edit and refine video content for multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate with creative and marketing teams on campaign execution.
  • Export optimized deliverables for advertising, web, and social media.
  • Organize project files and maintain reusable animation assets.

In short: You create engaging motion content that enhances brand storytelling, improves audience engagement, and supports high-performing marketing campaigns.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of animation projects.
  • High-quality creative execution with minimal revision cycles.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with creative output.
  • Improved engagement, watch time, and CTR from animated assets.
  • Organized and reusable creative libraries.
  • Effective collaboration across creative and marketing teams.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote opportunity with U.S. business hours.
  • Work on high-impact marketing campaigns and brand storytelling.
  • Collaborate with experienced creative and marketing professionals.
  • Opportunity to build content seen across multiple digital platforms.
  • Career growth into Senior Motion Designer, Creative Lead, Art Director, or Motion Design Manager roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Portfolio Review & Motion Graphics Assessment
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Animator / Motion Graphics Designer who enjoys bringing ideas to life through compelling motion design, thrives in a fast-paced creative environment, and wants to create high-impact visual content that drives measurable results, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape engaging digital experiences for a growing organization.

Serving the People Who Serve the People

By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

The Technical Support Representative is a resident expert on the Customer Support team whose knowledge of software configurations, online payment system integrations, relational databases, scripting, web applications, networks and general knowledge of internet communication protocols provides a valuable insight for solving problems. They are master troubleshooters and follow consistent, logical steps to identify/replicate issues, isolate causes and report back to clients on resolution. This person will also work on other programming and documentation projects as required. The Technical Support team partners with the Customer Support team in maintaining a “Customer Focused” environment, partnering with our stakeholders to achieve the highest customer lifetime value and satisfaction. This role requires the individual to be a US Citizen and CJIS certified (FBI Background check).

  • Work directly with clients to understand issues, document in a case, and work towards resolution.
  • Uphold SLA’s regarding responsiveness on individual cases.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Customer Support Representatives and be the resident product subject matter expert for a specific product suite/team.

  • Validate and identify product bugs and be able to document the expected behaviors for resolution.

  • Resolving escalated customer complaints, especially when technical in nature, without the need for team lead or managerial intervention.

  • You’ve used ticketing systems such as Zendesk, JIRA, Salesforce or other.
  • You have a technical degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience (2+ yrs.).
Good to have but not mandatory if:

  • You have experience with administering windows desktops, servers and embedded systems
  • You have enterprise SaaS or web-hosted software knowledge.
  • You have experience with streaming/video playback
  • You have experience with Github, CI / CD, software deployment.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

The Impact

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what you can expect as a Puerto Rico-based team member:

About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior-level software engineer who leans backend and can take product problems from first principles through implementation. You’ll spend roughly 70% of your time on backend and distributed systems work and 20–30% on frontend work, giving you the ability to own features across the stack when needed.

You’ll help take new products and capabilities from early traction to meaningful scale — designing reliable backend systems while contributing the frontend components required to deliver complete product experiences. This work could include helping expand our new incrementality offering into a scalable experimentation platform, building near real-time data infrastructure or building AI into our marketing user's workflows. You'll have an opportunity to collaborate with a cross-functional team of data scientists, product managers, and designers along the way.

Your Impact

  • Scale our new incrementality product into a reliable, repeatable experimentation platform.
  • Develop near-real-time ingestion and processing capabilities to move beyond batch workflows.
  • Build new AI-powered workflows that help marketers evaluate performance and act on insights.
  • Improve connection-state systems and help extend the partner ecosystem across data ingestion and exports.
  • Work on other product areas such as role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Contribute to frontend work when needed to deliver complete experiences.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience designing and building distributed backend systems, microservices, APIs and/or data processing systems written in Python.
  • Multiple years of professional experience building system architecture.
  • Experience working closely with product managers, designers, and data scientists while independently driving implementation and delivery.
  • Previous startup experience or working in an environment where engineers need breadth, sound judgment, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated experience turning ambiguous product needs into sound technical architecture and production-ready solutions.
  • The ability to navigate complex datasets and interconnected tables to investigate issues, trace dependencies, and identify the right path forward in ambiguous technical situations.
  • Working frontend experience with technologies such as React and TypeScript; deep frontend specialization is not required.
  • Strong coding fundamentals and the ability to solve technical problems independently, with AI used as an accelerator rather than a substitute for core capabilities.
  • A generalist mindset and willingness to work across backend, frontend, pipelines, and infrastructure when the product requires it.

You may be a strong fit if

  • Most of your experience is in data-intensive backend engineering, but you have also shipped frontend work.
Base Salary Range
$170,000—$200,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.
